jobs.title: Senior Scientist QA Operations
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Flex with On Call Duty

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific's Quality Assurance team and contribute to our mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Quality Engineer II, you will ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements across our manufacturing operations. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, lead investigations, and implement corrective actions to maintain our high standards of product quality. This role offers exposure to innovative technologies and the opportunity to directly impact patient care through quality oversight of critical products.
REQUIREMENTS:
• Advanced Degree with no prior experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of quality assurance experience in GMP/ISO regulated environments, preferably in medical devices, pharmaceuticals or biotechnology
• Preferred Fields of Study: Life Sciences, Engineering, Chemistry or related scientific/technical field
• ISO 13485/FDA Lead Auditor certification beneficial
• ASQ certification (CQE, CQA) advantageous
• Strong knowledge of quality systems, cGMP regulations, and standards including ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820
• Expertise in quality tools and methodologies including risk management, root cause analysis, CAPA, and change control
• Demonstrated experience leading investigations, analyzing quality data, and implementing effective corrective actions
• Excellent documentation and technical writing skills for developing SOPs, protocols and reports
• Strong proficiency in quality management software (TrackWise, SAP QM, etc.) and Microsoft Office suite
• Experience conducting internal audits and supporting external regulatory inspections
• Demonstrated ability to build consensus and collaborate across functions
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively in team environments
• Strong attention to detail with analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Experience with statistical analysis tools and quality metrics reporting
• Project management skills and ability to prioritize effectively
• Ability to work in clean room environments when required
• Foreign language skills beneficial

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. DESCRIZIONE:
Unisciti al team di Quality Assurance di Thermo Fisher Scientific e contribuisci alla nostra missione per rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. In qualità di Ingegnere di Qualità II, garantirai la conformità agli standard di qualità e ai requisiti normativi nelle nostre operazioni di produzione. Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo, indagini di piombo e implementare azioni correttive per mantenere i nostri elevati standard di qualità del prodotto. Questo ruolo offre l'esposizione a tecnologie innovative e l'opportunità di influenzare direttamente la cura del paziente attraverso la supervisione della qualità dei prodotti critici.
PRESCRIZIONI:
• Laurea avanzata senza esperienza precedente, o Bachelor's Degree più 2 anni di esperienza di garanzia della qualità in ambienti regolamentati GMP / ISO, preferibilmente in dispositivi medici, farmaci o biotecnologie
• Campi di studio preferiti: Scienze della vita, Ingegneria, Chimica o relativo campo scientifico/tecnico
• ISO 13485/FDA Lead Auditor certificazione benefico
• ASQ certificazione (CQE, CQA) vantaggiosa
• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi di qualità, dei regolamenti cGMP e degli standard tra cui ISO 13485, 21 CFR Parte 820
• Competenza in strumenti di qualità e metodologie tra cui la gestione del rischio, l'analisi delle cause radice, CAPA e il controllo dei cambiamenti
• Esperienza dimostrata che conduce indagini, analizzando i dati di qualità e implementando azioni correttive efficaci
• Eccellente documentazione e capacità di scrittura tecnica per lo sviluppo di SOP, protocolli e report
• Forte competenza nel software di gestione della qualità (TrackWise, SAP QM, ecc.) e Microsoft Office suite
• Esperienza con la conduzione di audit interni e il supporto di ispezioni normative esterne
• Capacità dimostrata di costruire il consenso e collaborare attraverso le funzioni
• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo efficacemente negli ambienti di squadra
• Forte attenzione ai dettagli con capacità analitiche e di problem solving

• Capacità di gestione del progetto e capacità di priorità in modo efficace
• Capacità di lavorare in ambienti puliti quando necessario
• Capacità linguistiche utili

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Rejoignez l'équipe d'assurance de la qualité de Thermo Fisher Scientific et contribuez à notre mission de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. En tant qu'ingénieur de la qualité II, vous assurerez la conformité aux normes de qualité et aux exigences réglementaires dans toutes nos activités de fabrication. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue, mener des enquêtes et mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives pour maintenir nos normes élevées de qualité des produits. Ce rôle offre une exposition aux technologies novatrices et la possibilité d'influer directement sur les soins aux patients en surveillant la qualité des produits essentiels.
EXIGENCES:
• Avancé Diplôme sans expérience préalable, ou Baccalauréat plus 2 ans d'expérience d'assurance de la qualité dans les environnements réglementés GMP/ISO, de préférence dans les dispositifs médicaux, les produits pharmaceutiques ou la biotechnologie
• Domaines d'études préférés: Sciences de la vie, génie, chimie ou domaine scientifique/technique connexe
• Certification ISO 13485/FDA du vérificateur principal bénéfique
• Certification ASQ (CQE, CQA) avantageuse
• Forte connaissance des systèmes de qualité, des règlements et des normes du GMPc, y compris ISO 13485, 21 CFR Part 820
• Expertise en outils et méthodes de qualité, y compris la gestion des risques, l'analyse des causes profondes, l'ACAP et le contrôle du changement
• Expérience démontrée menant des enquêtes, analysant des données de qualité et mettant en oeuvre des mesures correctives efficaces
• Excellente capacité de documentation et de rédaction technique pour l'élaboration de SOP, protocoles et rapports
• Bonne maîtrise des logiciels de gestion de la qualité (TrackWise, SAP QM, etc.) et de la suite Microsoft Office
• Expérience en matière de vérification interne et d'inspections réglementaires externes
• Capacité démontrée de parvenir à un consensus et de collaborer entre les fonctions
• Fortes compétences en communication verbale et écrite
• Aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant efficacement en équipe
• Une grande attention aux détails avec des capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Expérience des outils d'analyse statistique et des rapports de qualité
• Compétences en gestion de projet et aptitude à établir des priorités efficaces
• Capacité de travailler dans des environnements propres au besoin
• Compétences linguistiques étrangères bénéfiques

jobs.title: Senior Scientist microbiological Quality Control
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Location/Division Specific Information:

This position is part of the Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) team from Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), supporting GMP-regulated manufacturing operations. The role operates within a laboratory environment focused on ensuring microbiological quality and compliance of pharmaceutical products and processes.

## A Day in the Life:

- Coordinate and work on the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Actively contribute to the GMP Inspection Readiness of QC to ensure the fully compliance of relevant Quality System and Procedural documents.
- Actively contribute to the QC operational readiness managing projects (external and internal) and the assigned to ressources (including coordination of people daily tasks). Participates in the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Responsible for development, transfer and validation of analytical procedures professionally and according to timelines.
- Ensure ready to state activities in the MBQC lab.
- Collaboration in the solution of MBQC problematic and / or questions (quality problems, government inquiries, etc.).
- Supporting of laboratory employee during troubleshooting activities.
- Efficient communication: Informing the MBQC head in a timely manner regarding ongoing business activities, deviations, and problems within the team.
- Responsible for writing and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and instructions (Wis) professionally and according to timelines.
- Responsible for SME review and approval of methods, plans, protocols and reports, gap assessments

## Education & Experience:

- Degree (Master or higher) in the Microbiology or Life Science Area
- At least 5 years experience in microbiological laboratories including experience in a regulated GMP environment.

## Knowledge, Abilities:

- Extensive knowledge of microbiological testing techniques (bioburden, endotoxin, qPCR) and laboratory best practices
- Strong knowledge of cGMP requirements, method validation/verification, and documentation standards (SOPs, WIs)
- Ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues, support investigations, and collaborate in cross-functional teams
- Fluent English (written and spoken), German is a plus

## What We Offer:

- Compensation
- Competitive Pay
- Performance Related Bonus where eligible
- Annual merit performance-based increase

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

## Location/Division Informazioni specifiche:

Questa posizione fa parte del team Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) di Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), che supporta le operazioni di produzione regolate da GMP. Il ruolo opera all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio mirato a garantire la qualità microbiologica e la conformità dei prodotti e processi farmaceutici.

## Un giorno nella vita:

- Coordinare e lavorare sul trasferimento, lo sviluppo e la convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Contribuire attivamente alla disponibilità di controllo GMP di QC per garantire la piena conformità del relativo sistema di qualità e documenti procedurali.
- Contribuire attivamente ai progetti di gestione della disponibilità operativa QC (esterno e interno) e alle risorse assegnate (compreso il coordinamento delle attività quotidiane delle persone). Partecipa al trasferimento, allo sviluppo e alla convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Responsabile per lo sviluppo, il trasferimento e la validazione di procedure analitiche professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Assicurarsi di essere pronti a svolgere attività nel laboratorio MBQC.
- Collaborazione nella soluzione di MBQC problematico e / o domande (problemi di qualità, indagini governative, ecc.).
- Supporto dei dipendenti di laboratorio durante le attività di risoluzione dei problemi.
- Comunicazione efficiente: Informare la testa di MBQC in modo tempestivo sulle attività aziendali in corso, deviazioni e problemi all'interno del team.
- Responsabile per la scrittura e la revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni (Wis) professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Responsabile per la revisione e l'approvazione delle PMI di metodi, piani, protocolli e relazioni, valutazioni dei gap

## Istruzione e esperienza:

- Laurea (Master o superiore) in Microbiologia o Life Science Area
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in laboratori microbiologici tra cui l'esperienza in un ambiente GMP regolamentato.

## Conoscenza, abilità:

- Ampia conoscenza delle tecniche di test microbiologici (bioburden, endotossina, qPCR) e delle best practice di laboratorio
- Forte conoscenza dei requisiti cGMP, convalida dei metodi/verificazione e standard di documentazione (SOP, WIs)
- Capacità di risolvere problemi microbiologici, di sostenere le indagini e di collaborare in team interfunzionali
- Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato), tedesco è un plus

## Cosa offriamo:

- Compensazione
- Paga competitiva
- Prestazioni Bonus Correlato dove idoneo
- Aumento basato sulle prestazioni del merito annuale

## Umweltbedingungen

Einhaltung aller Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Sicherheitsstandards

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

## Standort/Bereichsspezifische Angaben:

Diese Position ist Teil des Teams für mikrobiologische Qualitätskontrolle (MBQC) von Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), das GMP-regulierte Fertigungsbetriebe unterstützt. Die Rolle spielt sich in einer Laborumgebung ab, die sich auf die Gewährleistung der mikrobiologischen Qualität und der Konformität pharmazeutischer Produkte und Prozesse konzentriert.

## Ein Tag im Leben:

- Koordination und Arbeit an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur GMP Inspection Readiness von QC, um die vollständige Einhaltung der relevanten Qualitätssicherungssysteme und Verfahrensunterlagen sicherzustellen.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur QC-Operational Readiness Management-Projekte (extern und intern) und die zugewiesenen Ressourcen (einschließlich der Koordination der täglichen Aufgaben der Menschen). Beteiligt sich an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Übertragung und Validierung von analytischen Verfahren professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie bereit sind, Aktivitäten im MBQC-Labor anzugeben.
- Zusammenarbeit bei der Lösung von MBQC-Problemen und / oder Fragen (Qualitätsprobleme, Regierungsanfragen usw.).
- Unterstützung von Labormitarbeitern bei der Fehlersuche.
- Effiziente Kommunikation: rechtzeitige Information des MBQC-Leiters über laufende Geschäftsaktivitäten, Abweichungen und Probleme im Team.
- Verantwortlich für das Schreiben und die Überarbeitung von Standard-Betriebsanweisungen (SOPs) und Anweisungen (Wis) professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Verantwortlich für die KMU-Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Methoden, Plänen, Protokollen und Berichten, Lückenbewertungen

## Bildung & Erfahrung:

- Grad (Master oder höher) in der Mikrobiologie oder Life Science Area
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in mikrobiologischen Labors, einschließlich Erfahrung in einer regulierten GMP-Umgebung.

## Wissen, Fähigkeiten:

- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über mikrobiologische Testverfahren (Bioburden, Endotoxin, qPCR) und bewährte Laborverfahren
- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der cGMP-Anforderungen, Methodenvalidierung/-verifizierung und Dokumentationsstandards (SOPs, WIs)
- Fähigkeit, mikrobiologische Probleme zu beheben, Untersuchungen zu unterstützen und in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten
- fließendes Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen), Deutsch ist ein Plus

## Was wir anbieten:

- Ausgleich
- Wettbewerbsfähiges Entgelt
- Leistungsbezogener Bonus, sofern zulässig
- Jährliche leistungsbasierte Steigerung

Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.

## Renseignements sur l'emplacement/la division :

Ce poste fait partie de l'équipe de contrôle de la qualité microbiologique (MBQC) de Thermo Fisher Scientific à Lengnau (CH), qui soutient les activités de fabrication réglementées par les BPF. Ce rôle fonctionne dans un environnement de laboratoire axé sur la qualité microbiologique et la conformité des produits et procédés pharmaceutiques.

## Un jour dans la vie:

- Coordonner et travailler au transfert, au développement et à la validation des méthodes d'analyse, y compris la qualification de l'équipement nécessaire à l'analyse.
- Contribuer activement à la préparation à l'inspection des BPF du QC afin d'assurer la conformité complète du système de qualité et des documents procéduraux pertinents.
- Contribuer activement à la préparation opérationnelle du CQ à la gestion des projets (externes et internes) et des ressources affectées (y compris la coordination des tâches quotidiennes des personnes). Participer au transfert, au développement et à la validation des méthodes d'analyse, y compris la qualification de l'équipement nécessaire à l'analyse.
- Responsable du développement, du transfert et de la validation des procédures d'analyse professionnelles et selon les délais.
- Assurez-vous d'être prêt à déclarer les activités dans le laboratoire du MBQC.
- Collaboration à la solution des problèmes et/ou des questions du CQMB (problèmes de qualité, enquêtes gouvernementales, etc.).
- Soutien aux employés de laboratoire pendant les activités de dépannage.
- Communication efficace : Informer le responsable du CQM en temps opportun des activités opérationnelles, des écarts et des problèmes au sein de l'équipe.
- Responsable de la rédaction et de la révision des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et des instructions (Wis) professionnellement et selon les délais.
- Responsable de l ' examen et de l ' approbation par les PME des méthodes, plans, protocoles et rapports, des évaluations des lacunes

## Éducation et expérience :

- Diplôme (maîtrise ou plus) en microbiologie ou sciences de la vie
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans des laboratoires microbiologiques, y compris une expérience dans un environnement BPF réglementé.

## Connaissances, capacités :

- Connaissance approfondie des techniques d'analyse microbiologique (biocharge, endotoxine, qPCR) et des meilleures pratiques de laboratoire
- Connaissance approfondie des exigences des BPFc, de la validation/vérification des méthodes et des normes de documentation (SOP, WI)
- Capacité de résoudre les problèmes microbiologiques, de soutenir les enquêtes et de collaborer dans des équipes interfonctionnelles
- Anglais (écrit et parlé), allemand est un plus

## Ce que nous offrons:

- Rémunération
- Rémunération concurrentielle
- Bonus lié à la performance lorsque admissible
- Augmentation annuelle fondée sur le rendement

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. ## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As an **Associate Project Manager** at Thermo Fisher Scientific's Clinical Trials Division, you will contribute to ensuring successful delivery of clinical trial projects and exceptional customer service. Working autonomously or supporting senior project managers, you will manage a portfolio of clinical trial projects, coordinating cross-functional activities from study setup through completion while serving as the primary point of contact for clients.

## Your responsibilities:

- Manage end-to-end project coordination, including study specifications, timeline development, budget management, and documentation
• Foster proactive communication and collaboration between internal departments and external clients
• Ensure timely delivery of services and products according to client requirements and quality standards
• Monitor project activities, identify and address risks, and implement solutions to keep projects on track
• Develop strong client relationships while representing their needs throughout internal processes
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and provide guidance to team members **Your Qualification:**
• Advanced Degree with no prior experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of experience, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: life sciences, healthcare, business or related field
• Project Management certification preferred
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP requirements and quality management systems
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities with demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects
• Advanced communication and presentation skills; able to effectively engage with clients and internal stakeholders
• Proficient in project management tools and MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
• Experience with relevant systems like Salesforce, GPMS, TrackWise preferred
• Demonstrated financial acumen and budget management capabilities
• Analytical approach with ability to identify and address risks
• Detail-oriented with excellent documentation and process compliance skills
• Self-directed while collaborating effectively in a matrix environment
• English fluency required; additional languages beneficial
• Travel required 10-25%
• Client-focused with demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional relationships

**We offer** competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

## Job Summary:

This position is responsible for ensuring operational EHS at the site and actively supports the implementation of EHS regulations and corporate requirements at the site level through various projects.

This position is also responsible for compliance with environmental regulations and emergency measures at the site and supports the site's operations and warehouse with fire protection and corresponding emergency planning. The EHS Sr. Specialist is the main point of contact for chemical accident and fire prevention at the site level within the framework of various projects.

The EHS Sr. Specialist works closely with all departments, by creating risk assessments, storage and preservation concepts, and training staff in safe behaviour.

## Main tasks:

- You support the departments in the implementation of EHS guidelines based on corporate requirements as well as national and local Swiss regulations.
- You support and advise departments and functional managers regarding EHS guidelines, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
- You monitor and ensure the effectiveness of EHS standards on site by conducting regular inspections.
- You take on the management of operational occupational hygiene and coordinate monitoring campaigns with external service providers.
- You create a prevention program and conduct EHS training, advertising, and communication to improve employees' awareness and competence in the EHS area.
- You ensure the introduction and targeted training of new tools - especially digital tools - that are to be used by employees at the site.
- You lead the Safety Committee at the site, which is composed of representatives from various departments.
- You will work closely with the energy team at the site to drive energy-saving projects forward.
- Together with FM, you will develop and maintain an effective training plan for contractors.
- You prepare exercises and ensure the effectiveness of emergency measures.
- You support and advise the warehouse in creating an appropriate storage concept.
- You take over the management of the first aid organization on site and train staff in firefighting and emergency measures.
- You organize and lead the emergency response team (evacuations)
- Together with facility management, you support the maintenance, inspection, and documentation of safety equipment on site, in particular
- Sprinkler system
- First aid equipment
- Fire alarm system
- You participate in the annual review of risk management and the claims insurance advisor.
- You conduct campaigns for fire and emergency prevention.
- You are part of the on-site emergency team.
- No travel requirements

## Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related field, with additional training in Occupational Safety, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- At least 5 years of experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
- Strong knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations.
- Experience in the chemical and/or pharmaceutical industry.
- Experience in occupational/industrial hygiene.
- Knowledge of biological hazards and biosafety is an advantage.
- Demonstrated ability to drive EHS initiatives, proactively engage relevant stakeholders, and foster a strong safety culture across the organization.
- Applies a practical and solution-focused mindset to support business objectives while consistently upholding regulatory and company standards.
- Acts as a trusted EHS advisor and primary point of contact, providing timely, practical, and effective guidance on EHS-related questions and challenges.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, both vertically and cross-functionally.
- Strong training, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple stakeholders and competing demands.
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Fluent in German with good English language skills.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and achieve goals within demanding timelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Ufficio

## Descrizione del lavoro

## Riepilogo del lavoro:

Questa posizione è responsabile di garantire l'EHS operativo sul sito e supporta attivamente l'implementazione di normative EHS e requisiti aziendali a livello del sito attraverso vari progetti.

Questa posizione è anche responsabile del rispetto delle normative ambientali e delle misure di emergenza sul sito e supporta le operazioni del sito e il magazzino con protezione antincendio e corrispondente pianificazione di emergenza. Lo specialista EHS Sr. è il punto principale di contatto per incidenti chimici e prevenzione antincendio a livello del sito nell'ambito di vari progetti.

Lo specialista EHS Sr. lavora a stretto contatto con tutti i dipartimenti, creando valutazioni di rischio, concetti di conservazione e conservazione e personale di formazione in comportamento sicuro.

## Principali compiti:

- L'utente sostiene i dipartimenti nell'attuazione delle linee guida EHS in base alle esigenze aziendali e alle normative svizzere nazionali e locali.
- L'utente supporta e consiglia i dipartimenti e i gestori funzionali per quanto riguarda le linee guida, le procedure, gli standard e i requisiti normativi.
- Monitorare e garantire l'efficacia degli standard EHS in loco conducendo ispezioni regolari.
- Accetti la gestione dell'igiene del lavoro e coordina le campagne di monitoraggio con i fornitori di servizi esterni.
- Creare un programma di prevenzione e condurre la formazione, la pubblicità e la comunicazione EHS per migliorare la consapevolezza e la competenza dei dipendenti nell'area EHS.
- Assicura l'introduzione e la formazione mirata di nuovi strumenti - soprattutto strumenti digitali - che devono essere utilizzati dai dipendenti del sito.
- Lei guida il comitato di sicurezza sul sito, che è composto da rappresentanti di vari dipartimenti.
- Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di energia del sito per guidare i progetti di risparmio energetico in avanti.
- Insieme con FM, si svilupperà e manterrà un piano di formazione efficace per gli appaltatori.
- Preparate gli esercizi e assicurate l'efficacia delle misure di emergenza.
- Supporta e consiglia il magazzino nella creazione di un concetto di storage appropriato.
- Si prende il controllo della gestione della prima organizzazione di aiuti sul sito e il personale di treno in misure antincendio e di emergenza.
- Si organizza e guida il team di risposta di emergenza (evacuazioni)
- Insieme alla gestione delle strutture, supporta la manutenzione, l'ispezione e la documentazione delle attrezzature di sicurezza in loco, in particolare
- Sistema di spruzzi
- Attrezzature di pronto soccorso
- Sistema di allarme antincendio
- Partecipa alla revisione annuale della gestione del rischio e del consulente di assicurazione crediti.
- Conduci campagne di prevenzione incendi e di emergenza.
- Fai parte del team di emergenza in loco.
- Nessun requisito di viaggio

## Requisiti/Qualificazioni:

- Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Chimica, Scienze Ambientali, o un campo correlato, con formazione aggiuntiva in Sicurezza del Lavoro, o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e esperienza professionale.
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS).
- Forte conoscenza delle normative locali in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.
- Esperienza nell'industria chimica e/o farmaceutica.
- Esperienza nell'igiene professionale/industriale.
- La conoscenza dei pericoli biologici e della biosicurezza è un vantaggio.
- Dimostrata capacità di guidare iniziative EHS, coinvolgere proattivamente le parti interessate pertinenti e promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione.
- Si basa su una mentalità pratica e orientata alla soluzione per supportare gli obiettivi aziendali, mantenendo costantemente gli standard normativi e aziendali.
- Agisce come consulente EHS di fiducia e punto di contatto primario, fornendo una guida tempestiva, pratica ed efficace sulle domande e le sfide relative alla EHS.
- Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, sia verticalmente che cross-funzionalmente.
- Forte formazione, coaching e capacità di problem solving.
- Eccellente capacità organizzativa con la capacità di priorità in modo efficace e gestire più stakeholder e richieste concorrenti.
- Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta.
- Fluente in tedesco con buone abilità di lingua inglese.
- Automotivata con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, prendere la proprietà e raggiungere gli obiettivi entro tempi difficili.

## Arbeitsübersicht:

Diese Position ist verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung des operativen EHS am Standort und unterstützt aktiv die Umsetzung von EHS-Vorschriften und Unternehmensanforderungen auf Standortebene durch verschiedene Projekte.

Diese ist auch für die Einhaltung von Umweltauflagen und Notfallmaßnahmen am Standort verantwortlich und unterstützt den Betrieb und das Lager mit Brandschutz und entsprechender Notfallplanung. Der EHS Sr. Specialist ist im Rahmen verschiedener Projekte die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Chemieunfall- und Brandschutz auf Standortebene.

Der EHS Senior Specialist arbeitet eng mit allen Abteilungen zusammen, indem er Risikobewertungen, Lager- und Konservierungskonzepte erstellt und das Personal in sicherem Verhalten ausbildet.

## Hauptaufgaben:

- Sie unterstützen die Abteilungen bei der Umsetzung von EHS-Richtlinien basierend auf Unternehmensanforderungen sowie nationalen und lokalen Schweizer Vorschriften.
- Sie unterstützen und beraten Abteilungen und Funktionsmanager in Bezug auf EHS-Richtlinien, Verfahren, Standards und regulatorische Anforderungen.
- Sie überwachen und gewährleisten die Wirksamkeit der EHS-Standards vor Ort durch regelmäßige Inspektionen.
- Sie übernehmen das Management der betrieblichen Arbeitshygiene und koordinieren Monitoring-Kampagnen mit externen Dienstleistern.
- Sie erstellen ein Präventionsprogramm und führen EHS-Schulungen, Werbung und Kommunikation durch, um das Bewusstsein und die Kompetenz der Mitarbeiter im EHS-Bereich zu verbessern.
- Sie sorgen für die Einführung und gezielte Schulung neuer Tools – insbesondere digitaler Tools –, die von Mitarbeitern vor Ort eingesetzt werden sollen.
- Sie leiten den Sicherheitsausschuss vor Ort, der sich aus Vertretern verschiedener Abteilungen zusammensetzt.

- Zusammen mit FM entwickeln und pflegen Sie einen effektiven Schulungsplan für Auftragnehmer.

- Sie organisieren und leiten das Notfallteam (Evakuierungen)
- Gemeinsam mit dem Facility Management unterstützen Sie insbesondere die Wartung, Inspektion und Dokumentation von Sicherheitseinrichtungen vor Ort.

- Erste-Hilfe-Ausrüstung
- Brandmeldeanlage
- Sie nehmen an der jährlichen Überprüfung des Risikomanagements und des Schadenversicherungsberaters teil.
- Sie führen Kampagnen zur Brand- und Notfallprävention durch.
- Sie sind Teil des Notfallteams vor Ort.
- Keine Reiseanforderungen

## Résumé de l'emploi :

Ce poste est chargé d'assurer l'ESE opérationnelle au site et appuie activement la mise en oeuvre des règlements sur l'ESE et des exigences ministérielles au niveau du site par le biais de divers projets.

Ce poste est également responsable de la conformité avec la réglementation environnementale et les mesures d'urgence sur le site et soutient les opérations et l'entrepôt du site avec la protection contre les incendies et la planification d'urgence correspondante. Le spécialiste EHS est le principal point de contact pour les accidents chimiques et la prévention des incendies au niveau du site dans le cadre de divers projets.

Le spécialiste EHS Sr. travaille en étroite collaboration avec tous les ministères, en créant des évaluations des risques, des concepts de stockage et de préservation et en formant le personnel à un comportement sécuritaire.

## Principales tâches:

- Vous accompagnez les départements dans la mise en œuvre des directives EHS basées sur les exigences de l'entreprise ainsi que sur les réglementations suisses nationales et locales.
- Vous aidez et conseillez les ministères et les gestionnaires fonctionnels au sujet des lignes directrices, des procédures, des normes et des exigences réglementaires en matière de SSE.
- Vous surveillez et vous assurez de l'efficacité des normes EHS sur place en effectuant des inspections régulières.
- Vous prenez en charge la gestion de l'hygiène opérationnelle et coordonnez les campagnes de suivi avec les prestataires de services externes.
- Vous créez un programme de prévention et effectuez de la formation, de la publicité et de la communication sur l'ESS afin d'améliorer la sensibilisation et la compétence des employés dans le domaine de l'ESS.
- Vous assurez l'introduction et la formation ciblée de nouveaux outils - en particulier des outils numériques - qui seront utilisés par les employés sur le site.
- Vous dirigez le comité de sécurité sur le site, qui est composé de représentants de différents départements.
- Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe énergétique du site pour faire avancer les projets d'économie d'énergie.
- Avec FM, vous élaborerez et maintiendrez un plan de formation efficace pour les entrepreneurs.
- Vous préparez des exercices et assurez l'efficacité des mesures d'urgence.
- Vous aidez et conseillez l'entrepôt en créant un concept de stockage approprié.
- Vous prenez en charge la gestion de l'organisme de premiers soins sur place et formez le personnel à la lutte contre les incendies et aux mesures d'urgence.
- Vous organisez et dirigez l'équipe d'intervention d'urgence (évacuations)
- En plus de la gestion de l'installation, vous soutenez l'entretien, l'inspection et la documentation de l'équipement de sécurité sur place, en particulier
- Système d'arrosage
- Matériel de premiers secours
- Système d'alarme incendie
- Vous participez à l'examen annuel de la gestion des risques et du conseiller en assurance des sinistres.
- Vous mènez des campagnes de prévention des incendies et des urgences.
- Vous faites partie de l'équipe d'urgence sur place.
- Pas de frais de voyage

## Exigences/Qualifications

- Baccalauréat en génie, chimie, sciences de l'environnement, ou un domaine connexe, avec une formation supplémentaire en sécurité au travail, ou une combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience professionnelle.
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en environnement, santé et sécurité (SHS).
- Bonne connaissance des règlements locaux en matière de santé et de sécurité au travail.
- Expérience dans l'industrie chimique et/ou pharmaceutique.
- Expérience en hygiène du travail/industrielle.
- La connaissance des dangers biologiques et de la biosécurité est un avantage.
- Capacité démontrée de diriger des initiatives en matière de SHE, d'engager activement les intervenants pertinents et de favoriser une solide culture de sécurité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
- Applique un état d'esprit pratique et axé sur la solution pour soutenir les objectifs commerciaux tout en respectant les normes réglementaires et les normes de l'entreprise.
- Agir en tant que conseiller en SSE et principal point de contact, en fournissant des conseils opportuns, pratiques et efficaces sur les questions et les défis liés à la SSE.
- Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les intervenants à tous les niveaux de l'organisation, tant verticalement qu'interfonctionnellement.
- Une solide formation, un encadrement et des compétences en résolution de problèmes.
- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de prioriser efficacement et de gérer plusieurs intervenants et demandes concurrentes.
- Compétences exceptionnelles en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement à tous les niveaux organisationnels.
- Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite.
- Fluent en allemand avec de bonnes compétences en langue anglaise.
- Automotivé par la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de s'approprier et d'atteindre des objectifs dans des délais exigeants.

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Warehouse

## Job Description

Job Title: Goods Receipt Specialist

Reports to: Team Leader Goods In

Career Band: 2

Division: Clinical Trial Division (CTD)

## Position Summary

The Goods Receipt Specialist is responsible for the timely receipt, booking, and storage of materials. The role records deviations in the TrackWise system and supports investigations. The incumbent ensures compliance with SOPs, GCP, cGMP, and safety requirements and monitors documentation practices within the eDMS.

## Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, GxP guidelines, and internal/external safety regulations
- Receive goods, post goods receipts in GPMS, and hand over shipments to freight carriers
- Perform high-bay warehouse picking activities and related WMS transactions
- Physically store materials and perform GPMS/WMS postings
- Execute required material movements, including transfers to external storage locations
- Operate machinery and equipment used for material handling
- Conduct inventory counts
- Clean facilities, machinery, and equipment according to instructions
- Support other departments as directed by supervisors

## Minimum Qualifications

- Completed vocational training in logistics
- At least two years of experience in industry or logistics
- Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and move heavier materials
- Very good German language skills, written and spoken
- Strong communication skills
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a multicultural environment
- Ability to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks
- Strong teamwork skills and resilience under stress
- Reliable, accurate, and efficient working style
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Preferred Qualifications

- Several years of experience in a regulated environment (e.g., pharmaceutical or food industry)
- Forklift license
- Class B driving license
- English language skills, written and spoken

This job description does not include all duties and responsibilities. Additional function-related instructions and assignments requested by management must be followed.

German:

Job-Titel: Goods Receipt Specialist

Berichtet an: Team Leader Goods In

Karriere-Band: 2

## Zusammenfassende Positionsbeschreibung

Der Goods Receipt Specialist führt eine zeitgerechte Annahme, Einbuchung sowie Einlagerung von Materialien durch. Er erfasst Abweichungen im TrackWise-System und unterstützt Untersuchungen. Er stellt die Einhaltung gültiger SOPs, GCP-, cGMP- und Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften sicher und überwacht die Dokumentationspraxis im eDMS.

## Verantwortlichkeiten

- Einhaltung von SOPs, GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen und externen Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften

- Hochregallager-Kommissionierungen sowie Verbuchung im WMS
- Physische Einlagerung von Waren und Buchung im GPMS/WMS
- Durchführung notwendiger Warenbewegungen inklusive Transporte ins Aussenlager
- Bedienung von Maschinen und Ausrüstungen zur Warenbewegung
- Durchführung von Inventuren
- Reinigung von Räumlichkeiten, Maschinen und Ausrüstungen gemäss Anweisungen
- Einsatz in anderen Abteilungen gemäss Weisung der Vorgesetzten

## Minimale Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker
- Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Industrie/Logistik
- Fähigkeit länger zu stehen und zu laufen sowie schwere Materialien zu bewegen
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten
- Selbstständige Arbeitsweise auch unter Druck in einem multikulturellen Umfeld
- Fähigkeit, Zeitvorgaben einzuhalten und Tätigkeiten zu priorisieren
- Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Stressbeständigkeit
- Zuverlässige, genaue und effiziente Arbeitsweise
- Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem regulierten Arbeitsumfeld (z. B. Pharma- oder Lebensmittelindustrie)
- Staplerführerschein
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Englische Sprachfertigkeiten in Wort und Schrift

jobs.title: Manager, QA Operations
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office

## Job Description

## Position Purpose

The QA Manager leads Quality Operations activities at the Lengnau site, ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, internal Quality standards, and customer commitments.

The role provides leadership to the QA Operations team and Quality oversight across Manufacturing, QC, Supply Chain, and related operational functions. The QA Manager is accountable for product and process compliance decisions and ensures effective management of batch disposition, Quality events, APQRs, operational Quality oversight, and continuous improvement. The position works closely with site leadership, cross-functional teams, customers, auditors, and regulatory authorities and promotes a strong Quality Culture across the organization.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop the QA Operations team, ensuring appropriate resources, priorities, and performance.
- Provide Quality leadership and independent, risk-based decision-making for operational and product-related matters.
- Ensure QA review and approval of master batch records, specifications, and relevant GMP documentation.
- Ensure timely batch disposition/release of raw materials, buffers, media, intermediates, and drug substances.
- Oversee Quality systems including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, complaints, OOS/OOT, and associated investigations.
- Review and approve method transfers, method validations, and specifications, as applicable.
- Lead APQR/PQR preparation and ensure timely completion and appropriate follow-up of identified trends and actions.
- Lead QA shop-floor/Gemba oversight and promote proactive identification and mitigation of Quality risks.
- Provide Quality oversight of Supply Chain activities, including material transfers, logistics, chain of custody, and shipment.
- Serve as a key QA contact for customers and support customer audits and regulatory inspections.
- Maintain inspection readiness and ensure timely resolution and escalation of significant Quality and compliance issues.
- Monitor Quality performance and trends and drive sustainable continuous improvement without compromising product quality or compliance.
- Participate in site and global Quality initiatives and promote a strong Quality Culture.

## Education

- Master's degree in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered.

## Experience & Competencies

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and/or GMP operations within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
- Demonstrated people leadership/management experience in a GMP environment.
- Strong knowledge of biological pharmaceutical manufacturing, Quality systems, and cGMP requirements.
- Strong knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, particularly Swissmedic, US FDA, EU GMP, and ICH guidelines.
- Experience with batch disposition, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, complaints, OOS/OOT, APQR/PQR, and operational Quality oversight.
- Experience supporting customer audits and regulatory inspections.

## Job Description

## Position Purpose

The QA Manager leads Quality Operations activities at the Lengnau site, ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements, regulatory expectations, internal Quality standards, and customer commitments.

The role provides leadership to the QA Operations team and Quality oversight across Manufacturing, QC, Supply Chain, and related operational functions. The QA Manager is accountable for product and process compliance decisions and ensures effective management of batch disposition, Quality events, APQRs, operational Quality oversight, and continuous improvement. The position works closely with site leadership, cross-functional teams, customers, auditors, and regulatory authorities and promotes a strong Quality Culture across the organization.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and develop the QA Operations team, ensuring appropriate resources, priorities, and performance.
- Provide Quality leadership and independent, risk-based decision-making for operational and product-related matters.
- Ensure QA review and approval of master batch records, specifications, and relevant GMP documentation.
- Ensure timely batch disposition/release of raw materials, buffers, media, intermediates, and drug substances.
- Oversee Quality systems including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, complaints, OOS/OOT, and associated investigations.
- Review and approve method transfers, method validations, and specifications, as applicable.
- Lead APQR/PQR preparation and ensure timely completion and appropriate follow-up of identified trends and actions.
- Lead QA shop-floor/Gemba oversight and promote proactive identification and mitigation of Quality risks.
- Provide Quality oversight of Supply Chain activities, including material transfers, logistics, chain of custody, and shipment.
- Serve as a key QA contact for customers and support customer audits and regulatory inspections.
- Maintain inspection readiness and ensure timely resolution and escalation of significant Quality and compliance issues.
- Monitor Quality performance and trends and drive sustainable continuous improvement without compromising product quality or compliance.
- Participate in site and global Quality initiatives and promote a strong Quality Culture.

- Master's degree in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and/or GMP operations within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.

- Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and risk-based decision-making skills.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and effectively collaborate across functions and organizational levels.

- Participation in the departmental on-call service, including second-level remote support, according to department organization.

jobs.title: Client Services Project Support Associate
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **Description:**

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.

## Your Role in that Mission:

As a member of Global Client Services, you are part of One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results for our customers and their patients.

The Project Support Associate is a key member of our Project Management team and provides crucial support which enables unparalleled service to our clients. This role partners with internal and external customers to monitor the daily progress of client project results and plays a key role in documentation and ensuring an excellent customer experience. The PSA role supports the PM client portfolio to ensure successful completion and supply maintenance over the life cycle of each project.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Partners with the internal project management team to help support the success of a study in any way possible.
- Assists in setting up and maintaining study filing systems and maintains accurate records for all work undertaken, working with appropriate quality management systems.
- Collaborates with the Project Manager for ensuring that all Fisher Clinical activities come together in a timely manner to meet the customer and study requirements.
- Gets results through the use of appropriate project planning tools to communicate achievements and critical path activities and responsibilities.
- Creates and/ or supports creation of operational documentation using internal systems including but not limited to GMP operational documentation. Build bill of materials and coordinates creation and review of billing packages.
- Collects all information on a study design including; accurate label texts, coordination of primary, secondary packaging material and tools, coordination of label translation, producing all batch documentation for operations and check of documentation and GMP instructions.
- Applies GXP in all areas of responsibility7

## As Demonstrated By:

Project Management

- General understanding of project plans and timeline management with a demonstrated track record for task delivery to enable achievement of goals.
- Knowledge of general inventory, good documentation practices, and report generation.
- Identifies and raises project challenges and collaborates with team members or management to resolve issues.
- Communicates information in a timely manner, understands boundaries, respects differences and addresses challenging situations appropriately.

## Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
- Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
- Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
- Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
- Effective written and verbal communication skills
- Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
- Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
- Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
- Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
- Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
- Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail

descriptionByLocale.it:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

The Client Services Project Manager I at Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. presents an outstanding chance to excel in a dynamic project management role. You will be instrumental in delivering impeccable service to our clients, ensuring world-class project execution and client happiness. Your ambition and collaboration will drive the success of various projects, leaving a significant impact in the scientific community.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with internal teams to establish project objectives and ensure outstanding study results.
- Establish and maintain study filing systems and accurate records, adhering strictly to quality management systems.
- Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure timely execution of project activities, meeting both customer and study requirements.
- Coordinate and communicate all relevant activities to ensure that services and products are ready as required by the customer.
- Use project planning tools to track achievements and critical activities, ensuring seamless project delivery.
- Build and support operational documentation, including GMP operational documentation, bill of materials, and billing packages.
- Provide backup support to the Project Team, ensuring consistent project progress.
- Collect information on study design, including label texts, packaging materials, label translation, batch documentation, logistics coordination, and GMP instructions.
- Apply GXP principles in all areas of responsibility.

## As Shown By:

- General understanding of project plans and timeline management with a proven track record for successful task delivery.
- Understanding of inventory and billing principles, documentation practices, and report generation.
- Ability to identify project challenges and collaborate with team members or management for effective resolution.
- Experience in supporting senior Project Managers in planning and coordinating functional team activities, timelines, and results.

## Client Relationship Management

- Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Thermo Fisher's solutions portfolio and industry strategy.
- Collaborate on special projects, reports, and meeting preparations, including agenda generation, scenario planning, and timeline monitoring.

## Technical Knowledge

- Perform basic data analysis functions with assistance from senior team members as required to ensure successful project results and customer satisfaction.
- Efficiently record and monitor project data in different systems, maintaining accountability for data accuracy, reporting, and timeliness.

## Project Management Leadership

- Seek mentorship and guidance to improve project management skills.
- Communicate information timely, understand boundaries, respect differences, and address challenging situations appropriately.

## Key Requirements:

- Education: Commercial apprenticeship or equivalent.
- Years of Experience: 1+ year of experience in project coordination, documentation and/or administration (preferably Pharmaceutical Industry)
- Fluent English, German beneficial

## Programma di lavoro

7 1/2 ora

## Condizioni ambientali

Magazzino

## Descrizione del lavoro

## Sintesi della funzione:

Lavorazione indipendente di processi di spedizione standardizzati e più complessi e supporto del team nel business quotidiano. L'attività comprende la raccolta, l'imballaggio, la preparazione della spedizione e la consegna di spedizioni a fornitori di servizi logistici, se necessario. Tutte le istruzioni di lavoro interne (SOP), i requisiti di qualità e le normative nazionali e internazionali di trasporto sono rispettati. Supporta la spedizione sicura e tempestiva di spedizioni ambientali, refrigerate e congelate in tutto il mondo. Le vostre attività principali:Procedimento e priorità indipendente della raccolta di ordini di spedizione standardizzati giornalieri e imballaggio di materiali di prova clinici complessiProcedimento di diversi tipi di spedizione / spedizioni controllate dalla temperatura Creazione indipendente della documentazione di spedizioneSupporto nuova documentazione dei dipendenti secondo l'analisi e il supporto degli errori GMP/GDPFirst in CAPAs e DeviationsCompliance con tutta la produzione SOPSSic dell'ordine di conformità del PIL e pulizia (SS)Cooperazione in LEAN, PPI e miglioramento continuo del processoLa gestione e l'ordinazione dell'area di lavoro secondo i principi 5S

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Flex with On Call Duty

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

When you join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll be part of an inquisitive team that shares your passion for exploration and discovery. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create significant contributions to the world.

## DESCRIPTION

How you will make an impact:

The Metrology Supervisor is responsible for leading metrology and calibration activities in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. This role ensures that all measuring and test equipment is compliant with regulatory requirements and supports product quality, patient safety, and data integrity. The position oversees a team of technicians, ensures adherence to ALCOA+ principles, and maintains inspection readiness at all times.

What you will do:

- Lead and supervise daily metrology and calibration operations within GMP areas (manufacturing, QC, laboratories, utilities)
- Ensure all instruments and systems are calibrated and maintained in compliance with GMP, FDA, EMA, and ISO standards
- Own and manage the calibration lifecycle: scheduling, execution, review, approval, and archival
- Ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) in all calibration records and electronic systems
- Review and approve calibration certificates, deviations, and out-of-tolerance (OOT) investigations
- Initiate and lead deviation, CAPA, and change control processes related to metrology activities
- Maintain full traceability to national/international standards (e.g., NIST)
- Support regulatory inspections and customer audits
- Ensure metrology processes align with validated systems and computerized system validation (CSV) requirements
- Collaborate with QA, Validation, Engineering, and Manufacturing to support equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Define and track KPIs related to compliance, turnaround time, and right-first-time performance
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance compliance and efficiency
- Train, qualify, and develop metrology personnel in GMP and technical competencies
- Adhere to general cGMP rules, Quality policies, procedures and instruction as rolled out by the Quality function and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives and deviation reporting and follow-up
- Adhere to general safety rules, policies, procedures and instructions as rolled out by the EHSS functions and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to safety initiatives and issues as well as near miss reporting and follow-up
- Maintain commitment to Thermo Fisher Scientific values and adherence to ethics and legal compliance standards
- Take personal accountability for presence, performance, and productivity for the achievements of defined objectives
- Think and act with a customer-centric mindset
- Embrace intellectual curiosity and Practical Process Improvement (PPI)

Reporting relationships:

The position reports to Director, Manufacturing Engineering and interacts with Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, EHSS, Quality Assurance, Service Contractors, and other team members.

## REQUIREMENTS

Education:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or related technical discipline

Experience & Competencies:

- 5–8+ years of experience in metrology/calibration within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment
- Prior experience supervising or leading teams strongly preferred
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (21 CFR Parts 210/211, Annex 11), FDA/EMA expectations
- Solid understanding of measurement uncertainty, risk-based calibration, and critical instrumentation
- Experience with CSV and data integrity requirements (ALCOA+)
- Familiarity with deviation/CAPA systems and quality management systems (QMS)
- Experience with electronic calibration and asset management systems

Additional Requirements:

- Strong leadership and team development
- Deep understanding of GMP compliance and regulatory expectations
- High attention to detail and documentation accuracy
- Root cause analysis and problem-solving (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone)
- Cross-functional communication and stakeholder management
- Audit readiness mindset

## Programma di lavoro

Flex con On Call Duty

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza, cleanroom: no prodotti per capelli, gioielli, trucco, smalto per unghie, profumo, piercing a vista, capelli facciali ecc... consentiti, Office, un certo grado di PPE (attrezzatura di protezione personale) richiesto (vetri di sicurezza, abiti, guanti, camice da laboratorio, tappi per orecchie ecc.)

## Descrizione del lavoro

Quando ti unisci a noi alla Thermo Fisher Scientific, sarai parte di un team inquisitivo che condivide la tua passione per l'esplorazione e la scoperta. Con ricavi di oltre 40 miliardi di dollari e il più grande investimento in R&D nel settore, diamo alle nostre persone le risorse e le possibilità di creare contributi significativi al mondo.

## DESCRIZIONE

Come si farà un impatto:

Il Metrology Supervisor è responsabile delle principali attività di metrologia e taratura in un ambiente farmaceutico regolamentato da GMP. Questo ruolo garantisce che tutte le apparecchiature di misura e test siano conformi ai requisiti normativi e supportino la qualità del prodotto, la sicurezza del paziente e l'integrità dei dati. La posizione supervisiona un team di tecnici, assicura l'aderenza ai principi ALCOA+ e mantiene sempre la disponibilità di ispezione.

Cosa farai:

- Guidare e supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane di metrologia e taratura nelle aree GMP (produzione, QC, laboratori, utilità)
- Assicurarsi che tutti gli strumenti e i sistemi siano calibrati e mantenuti in conformità agli standard GMP, FDA, EMA e ISO
- Possedere e gestire il ciclo di vita di calibrazione: pianificazione, esecuzione, revisione, approvazione e archivio
- Assicurare l'integrità dei dati (ALCOA+) in tutti i record di calibrazione e sistemi elettronici
- Valutazione e taratura approvano certificati, deviazioni e indagini di tolleranza (OOT)
- Avviare e condurre deviazione, CAPA e cambiare i processi di controllo relativi alle attività di metrologia
- Mantenere la piena tracciabilità agli standard nazionali/internazionali (ad esempio, NIST)
- Sostegno ispezioni normative e audit dei clienti
- Assicurare processi di metrologia allineati con sistemi convalidati e requisiti di validazione del sistema computerizzato (CSV)
- Collabora con QA, Validazione, Ingegneria e Produzione per supportare la qualificazione delle attrezzature (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Definire e monitorare i KPI relativi alla conformità, il tempo di svolta e le prestazioni di destra
- Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare la conformità e l'efficienza
- Formare, qualificare e sviluppare personale metrologico in GMP e competenze tecniche
- Adeguarsi alle regole cGMP generali, alle politiche di qualità, alle procedure e alle istruzioni presentate dalla funzione Qualità e approvate dalla gestione del sito
- Contribuire attivamente a continue iniziative di miglioramento della qualità e alla segnalazione e al follow-up delle deviazioni
- Adeguarsi alle regole generali di sicurezza, alle politiche, alle procedure e alle istruzioni presentate dalle funzioni EHSS e approvate dalla gestione del sito
- Contribuire attivamente a iniziative e problemi di sicurezza, nonché vicino a segnalazioni e follow-up mancanti
- Mantenere l'impegno per i valori scientifici Thermo Fisher e rispettare gli standard etici e legali
- Prendere la responsabilità personale per la presenza, le prestazioni e la produttività per i risultati di obiettivi definiti
- Pensare e agire con una mentalità orientata al cliente
- Abbraccia la curiosità intellettuale e il miglioramento del processo pratico (PPI)

Rapporti:

La posizione riporta a Direttore, Ingegneria manifatturiera e interagisce con Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, EHSS, Quality Assurance, Service Contractors e altri membri del team.

## PRESCRIZIONI

Istruzione:

- Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze della Vita, o disciplina tecnica correlata

Esperienza e competenze:

- 5-8+ anni di esperienza in metrologia/calibrazione all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico o biotecnologico GMP
- Prima esperienza di supervisione o squadre leader fortemente preferito
- Forte conoscenza delle normative GMP (21 parti CFR 210/211, allegato 11), aspettative FDA/EMA
- Solida comprensione dell'incertezza di misura, della calibrazione basata sul rischio e della strumentazione critica
- Esperienza con CSV e requisiti di integrità dei dati (ALCOA+)
- Familiarità con sistemi di deviazione/CAPA e sistemi di gestione della qualità (QMS)
- Esperienza con sistemi di taratura elettronica e gestione patrimoniale

Requisiti aggiuntivi:

- Forte leadership e sviluppo di team
- Profonda comprensione della conformità GMP e delle aspettative normative
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli e precisione della documentazione
- Analisi della causa della radice e risoluzione dei problemi (ad esempio, 5 Perché, Fishbone)
- Comunicazione interfunzionale e gestione degli stakeholder
- Audit mentalità di prontezza

## BESCHREIBUNG

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden:

Der Metrology Supervisor ist für die Leitung von Messtechnik- und Kalibrierungsaktivitäten in einer GMP-regulierten pharmazeutischen Umgebung verantwortlich. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass alle Mess- und Prüfgeräte den gesetzlichen Anforderungen entsprechen und die Produktqualität, Patientensicherheit und Datenintegrität unterstützen. - Maintenir une traçabilité complète aux normes nationales et internationales (p. ex., NIST)
- Soutenir les inspections réglementaires et les audits des clients
- Veiller à ce que les processus de métrologie soient conformes aux exigences des systèmes validés et de la validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV)
- Collaborer avec l'AQ, la validation, l'ingénierie et la fabrication pour appuyer la qualification de l'équipement (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Définir et suivre les ICR liés à la conformité, au délai d'exécution et à la bonne première fois
- Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer la conformité et l'efficacité
- Formation, qualification et perfectionnement du personnel de métrologie en BPF et en compétences techniques
- Adhérer aux règles générales du GMPc, aux politiques, procédures et instructions en matière de qualité mises en œuvre par la fonction Qualité et approuvées par la direction du site
- Contribuer activement aux initiatives d'amélioration continue de la qualité et aux rapports et suivis sur les écarts
- Adhérer aux règles, politiques, procédures et instructions générales de sécurité telles qu'elles sont appliquées par les fonctions de l'EHSS et approuvées par la direction du site
- Contribuer activement aux initiatives et aux enjeux en matière de sécurité ainsi qu'à la déclaration et au suivi quasi manquants
- Maintenir l'engagement envers les valeurs scientifiques de Thermo Fisher et le respect des normes d'éthique et de conformité juridique
- Prendre la responsabilité personnelle de la présence, du rendement et de la productivité pour les réalisations des objectifs définis
- Penser et agir avec une mentalité centrée sur le client
- Faire preuve de curiosité intellectuelle et d'amélioration des processus pratiques (PPI)

Rapports hiérarchiques :

Le poste relève du directeur, Ingénierie de fabrication et interagit avec les membres de l'équipe du génie, de l'entretien, de la fabrication, de l'EHSS, de l'assurance de la qualité, des fournisseurs de services et autres.

## EXIGENCES

Éducation:

- Baccalauréat en génie, sciences de la vie ou discipline technique connexe

Expérience et compétences :

- 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en métrologie/étalonnage dans un environnement pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique réglementé par les BPF
- Expérience préalable supervision ou chef d'équipes fortement préféré
- Bonne connaissance des règlements sur les BPF (21 parties CFR 210/211, annexe 11), attentes de la FDA et de l'EMA
- Compréhension solide de l'incertitude de mesure, de l'étalonnage fondé sur les risques et de l'instrumentation critique
- Expérience avec le CSV et les exigences d'intégrité des données (ALCOA+)
- Familiarité avec les systèmes de déviation/CAPA et les systèmes de gestion de la qualité (SGQ)
- Expérience des systèmes électroniques d'étalonnage et de gestion des actifs

Exigences supplémentaires:

- Un leadership solide et le développement d'équipes
- Connaissance approfondie de la conformité aux BPF et des attentes réglementaires
- Une grande attention aux détails et à la précision de la documentation
- Analyse des causes profondes et résolution des problèmes (p. ex., 5 Pourquoi, Fishbone)
- Communication interfonctionnelle et gestion des parties prenantes
- État d ' avancement de l ' audit

## Work Schedule

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.
REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
• Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
• Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
• Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
• Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
• Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
• Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
• Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
• Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail
• Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs. Arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Teams und Kunden zusammen, um den Studienerfolg zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig die höchsten Qualitätsstandards einzuhalten. Sie übernehmen Projektplanung, Dokumentationsmanagement und funktionsübergreifende Koordination, um Zeitpläne und Kundenerwartungen zu erfüllen. ANFORDERUNGEN:
