jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Rotational shift nights/weekends

## Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, No contact lens allowed; prescriptive glasses will be provided

## Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

The state-of-the-art multi-purpose manufacturing facility is crafted for large-scale production of biologics and has high expansion potential. After completion of construction activities, our site in Lengnau will offer highly flexible biomanufacturing technologies, from development to large-scale production including stainless steel equipment to meet our customer needs.

## Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation

Location: Lengnau

## Fixed contract until the end of 2026.

As a **Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation**, you conduct the production of recombinant products by operating automated production equipment and support project teams in the design, commissioning, qualification and validation of new production lines for recombinant products.

## Your responsibilities:

- Support operational readiness for Media buffer preparation, equipment preparation and cleaning.
- Participates in Technology Transfer of new products. Supports CVQ, PQ, Process Validation execution
- Responsible for the day-to-day execution of manufacturing activities in media & buffer preparation, equipment cleaning and preparation.
- Owns Work Instructions and SOP in their area
- Support Manufacturing Excellence to run robustly and efficiently.
- Participates in defining robust process parameters during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Participate in New Product Introduction activities

## Your qualifications:

- Degree in pharmaceutical, food or chemistry
- 1-3 years successful experience in pharmaceuticals operations in a GMP relevant environment
- Experience in pharmaceutical industry
- Hands on mentality
- Shift work is expected
- On-call duties is expected

**We offer** driven remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

This is an outstanding chance for a committed and ambitious professional to join our project management team at Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. The Senior Project Manager, Client Services Distribution leads all aspects of leadership and is responsible for the actions of project managers and project support associates. You will work closely to guarantee the timely and flawless delivery of clinical supplies projects and successfully implement processes to improve efficiency. While you will not coordinate day-to-day project activities, you will lead all aspects of your team's client portfolio, ensuring outstanding client happiness and consistent business delivery.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, mentor, and conduct yearly evaluations for Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Support Associates. Put into effect Performance Improvement Plans when needed.
- Establish goals for direct reports in alignment with company initiatives and vision.
- Direct the selection of projects and clients managed by the project management team, ensuring accurate and consistent delivery of customer projects.
- Provide assistance for customer issues advanced by Project Managers and Associate Project Managers.
- Identify, develop, and implement process improvements to improve overall efficiency and productivity.
- Address all personnel issues, timecard maintenance, and job descriptions for support associates.
- Participate in sales and marketing activities, including customer kickoffs, teleconferences, customer visits, audits, estimates, and quotations.
- Initiate and maintain continuous communication with appropriate departments.
- Provide regular training, including system and SOP training.
- Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices in all areas of responsibility.
- Demonstrate and promote the company vision and values.

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Accredited degree, preferably in a health-related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 5-7 years of experience supporting project management teams.
- Previous work experience in the Healthcare field required.
- 2 years of management experience.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent relationship building.
- Proven experience managing teams and working with customers in dynamic environments.
- In-depth understanding of clinical trials and business services.
- Proficient in using company SOPs and Quality standards.
- Excellent organizational, planning, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong customer management skills; proactive in anticipating and responding to client needs.
- Experience with both detailed execution and strategic orientation.

## Diversity and Inclusion Proficiencies:

- Drives Growth
- Builds Customer Allegiance
- Communicates Openly
- Builds Organizational Relationships
- Adapts to Process Improvement Environments

## Programma di lavoro Standard (Mon-Fri) ## Condizioni ambientali Ufficio ## Descrizione del lavoro Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro. ## Posizione Riepilogo: Questa è una grande opportunità per un professionista impegnato e ambizioso per unire il nostro team di project management presso Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. Il Senior Project Manager, Customer Services Distribution conduce tutti gli aspetti della leadership ed è responsabile delle azioni dei project manager e dei project support associati. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto per garantire la consegna tempestiva e impeccabile dei progetti di forniture cliniche e implementare con successo i processi per migliorare l'efficienza. Mentre non coordinate le attività di progetto quotidiane, guiderete tutti gli aspetti del portafoglio clienti del vostro team, garantendo una straordinaria felicità del cliente e una distribuzione aziendale coerente. ## Responsabilità chiave: - Sviluppare, mentore e condurre valutazioni annuali per Project Manager, Associate Project Manager e Project Support Associates. Mettere in vigore i piani di miglioramento delle prestazioni quando necessario. - Stabilire obiettivi per rapporti diretti in allineamento con le iniziative aziendali e la visione. - Dirigere la selezione di progetti e clienti gestiti dal team di gestione del progetto, garantendo una consegna accurata e coerente dei progetti dei clienti. - Fornire assistenza per i problemi dei clienti avanzata da Project Manager e Associate Project Managers. - Identificare, sviluppare e implementare i miglioramenti del processo per migliorare l'efficienza e la produttività complessiva. - Rivolgiti a tutti i problemi del personale, alla manutenzione delle cartoline e alle descrizioni dei lavori per i soci di supporto. - Partecipa alle attività di vendita e marketing, inclusi i kickoff dei clienti, le teleconferenze, le visite dei clienti, i controlli, le stime e le quotazioni. - Avviare e mantenere la comunicazione continua con i dipartimenti appropriati. - Fornire formazione regolare, compreso sistema e formazione SOP. - Seguite le buone pratiche di fabbricazione in tutti i settori di responsabilità. - Dimostrare e promuovere la visione e i valori aziendali. ##
• Requisiti minimi/qualificazioni: - Grado accreditato, preferibilmente in un campo di salute; grado avanzato preferito. - 5-7 anni di esperienza a supporto dei team di project management. - Esperienza di lavoro precedente nel campo sanitario richiesto. - 2 anni di esperienza manageriale. - Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, tra cui eccellente rapporto di costruzione. - Provata esperienza di gestione team e lavorare con i clienti in ambienti dinamici. - Comprensione approfondita degli studi clinici e dei servizi aziendali. - Proficiente nell'utilizzo di SOP aziendali e standard di qualità. - Eccellente capacità organizzativa, progettuale e analitica con la capacità di gestire più compiti e rispettare scadenze rigorose. - Forte capacità di gestione del cliente; proattivo nell'anticipare e rispondere alle esigenze del cliente. - Esperienza con esecuzione dettagliata e orientamento strategico. ## Proficienze di diversità e inclusione: - Aumenta la crescita - Costruisce l'assistenza clienti - Comunica apertamente - Costruisce relazioni organizzative - Adapts to Process Improvement Environments

Le gestionnaire principal de projet, Distribution des services à la clientèle, dirige tous les aspects du leadership et est responsable des actions des gestionnaires de projet et des associés de soutien de projet. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration pour garantir la livraison opportune et impeccable de projets de fournitures cliniques et mettre en œuvre avec succès des processus pour améliorer l'efficacité. Bien que vous ne coordonnez pas les activités quotidiennes du projet, vous dirigerez tous les aspects du portefeuille client de votre équipe, assurant ainsi le bonheur exceptionnel des clients et la prestation cohérente des activités. ## Principales responsabilités : - Élaborer, encadrer et effectuer des évaluations annuelles pour les gestionnaires de projet, les gestionnaires de projet associés et les associés de soutien de projet. Mettre en oeuvre des plans d'amélioration du rendement au besoin. - Établir des objectifs pour des rapports directs conformes aux initiatives et à la vision de l'entreprise. - Diriger la sélection des projets et des clients gérés par l'équipe de gestion de projet, en assurant la livraison précise et cohérente des projets clients. - Aider les gestionnaires de projet et les gestionnaires de projet associés à répondre aux questions des clients. - Déterminer, élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations de processus pour améliorer l'efficience et la productivité globales. - Résoudre tous les problèmes de personnel, la maintenance des cartes de temps et les descriptions de travail pour les associés de soutien. - Participer aux activités de vente et de marketing, y compris les lancements de clients, les téléconférences, les visites de clients, les vérifications, les estimations et les devis. - Entreprendre et maintenir une communication continue avec les ministères compétents. - Fournir une formation régulière, y compris une formation sur les systèmes et les SOP. - Adhérer aux bonnes pratiques de fabrication dans tous les domaines de responsabilité. - Démontrer et promouvoir la vision et les valeurs de l'entreprise. ##

## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

## Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. ist der weltweit führende Partner für die Wissenschaft mit einem Umsatz von 40 Mrd. USD und mehr als 120'000 Mitarbeitern in 60 Ländern. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Kunden in die Lage zu versetzen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen.

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. mit über 800 Mitarbeitern in der Schweiz und ist marktführend in den Bereichen Clinical Supply Chain Management Services und klinischer Prüfmusterherstellung sowie Logistik für Patienten weltweit. Für weitere Informationen über den Standort in Allschwil bei Basel, besuchen Sie unsere Website: [www.fisherclinicalservices.com](http://www.fisherclinicalservices.com/)

## Operator

## Zusammenfassung der Funktion:

Effiziente, zeitgerechte und GMP-gerechte Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Abschluss von Herstellungs- und Verpackungsaufträgen inkl. Durchführung von Inprozess-Kontrollen (IPCs), sowie Durchführung der Reinigung von Ausrüstungs- und Maschinenteilen.

## Ihre Aufgaben:

- Effiziente, zeitgerechte und GMP-gerechte Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Abschluss von Herstellungs- und Verpackungsaufträgen inkl. Durchführung von Inprozess-Kontrollen (IPCs)
- Effiziente und GMP-gerechte Durchführung der Reinigung von Ausrüstungs- und Maschinenteilen sowie von den Produktionsräumen
- GMP-gerechtes Dokumentieren der durchgeführten Arbeiten

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **Description:** Join an innovative team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll advance manufacturing excellence and contribute to impactful solutions. As a Staff Manufacturing Engineer, you'll provide technical leadership for complex manufacturing processes, equipment automation, and capital projects. You'll collaborate across multiple functions to enhance production efficiency, ensure product quality, and implement advanced technologies. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex technical challenges while supporting our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. **Requirements:**

- Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in manufacturing engineering in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, medical device, or biotechnology preferred)
- Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or related field)
- Professional Engineering designation or relevant certifications are assets
- Proven expertise in automation systems, PLC programming, and control system architecture
- Strong project management experience leading complex capital equipment and facility projects
- Experience with cGMP, FDA regulations, and quality management systems
- Advanced knowledge of manufacturing processes, including clean room operations
- Demonstrated ability to enhance processes using lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with data-driven decision making
- Experience developing validation protocols and documentation for regulated environments
- Expertise in CAD software, manufacturing execution systems, and production control systems
- Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a dynamic environment
- Success record of implementing innovative technical solutions
- Experience mentoring engineers and technical staff
- Up to 20% travel may be required
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and relevant engineering software packages
- Strong documentation and technical writing capabilities
- Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies
- Knowledge of safety protocols and regulatory compliance requirements
- Fluency in English and German

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety, and helping find cures for cancer.

Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you will make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

As an **Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems**, you will perform technical support activities and validation exercise to ensure product quality in a GMP-regulated environment. You will work with analytical equipment and electronic laboratory systems, supporting the qualification, validation, operation, and lifecycle management of QC systems and applications.

## Key Responsibilities

- Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical laboratory equipment and electronic laboratory systems.
- Support qualification of analytical equipment and computerized system validation activities for QC laboratory systems.
- Generate, review, and maintain GxP documentation throughout the lifecycle of QC systems, equipment, and applications.
- Evaluate analytical data, document results accurately, and ensure compliance with applicable quality standards.
- Support investigations related to out-of-specification, out-of-expectation, deviations, change controls, and corrective and preventive actions.
- Provide timely technical support to QC laboratory units to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
- Support inspection and audit readiness activities, including gap assessments, remediation actions, and participation in customer or health authority inspections as needed.
- Contribute to the implementation of automated data flows, laboratory process improvements, and Practical Process Improvement initiatives.
- Support data integrity expectations by ensuring reliable, complete, accurate, and compliant laboratory records.
- Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT, and global laboratory systems teams.
- Adhere to cGMP, quality, EHSS, and site procedures.
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement, safety initiatives, deviation reporting, and near-miss follow-up.
- Demonstrate Thermo Fisher Scientific values through accountability, ethical behavior, customer focus, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.

## Required Qualifications

- BSc or MSc in Lifes Sciences (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Microbiology or equivalent)
- Or IT/Automation background with strong knowledge and experience in the pharma industry
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, quality systems, and laboratory compliance requirements.
- Significant experience in a laboratory environment, experience in IT (Programming or Database)
- Computerized System Validation (CSV) and pharma industry Experience in Lab execution Systems as SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. is a benefit
- Demonstrated ability to analyze data and support investigations of out-of-specification or atypical results.
- Strong documentation skills and ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
- Familiarity with laboratory information management systems and electronic laboratory systems.
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards, including ISO, FDA, USP, and EP expectations.
- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

## Calendrier des travaux Norme (Mon-Fri) ## Conditions environnementales Respect de toutes les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) ## Description de l'emploi Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours : permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire progresser la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, y compris la protection de l'environnement, la sécurité alimentaire et la recherche de remèdes pour le cancer. Rejoignez notre équipe de contrôle de la qualité chez Thermo Fisher Scientific, où vous apporterez une contribution significative à notre mission de permettre aux clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. En tant que **Scientifique principal Systèmes de laboratoire électroniques**, vous effectuerez des activités de soutien technique et des exercices de validation pour assurer la qualité du produit dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipement analytique et les systèmes de laboratoire électroniques, en soutenant la qualification, la validation, le fonctionnement et la gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes et des applications de QC. ## Principales responsabilités - Exploiter, entretenir et dépanner l'équipement de laboratoire analytique et les systèmes de laboratoire électronique. - Appuyer la qualification du matériel d'analyse et les activités de validation des systèmes informatisés pour les systèmes de laboratoire de QC. - Générer, examiner et maintenir la documentation GxP tout au long du cycle de vie des systèmes, de l'équipement et des applications de QC. - Évaluer les données analytiques, documenter avec exactitude les résultats et assurer la conformité aux normes de qualité applicables. - Appuyer les enquêtes liées à la non-spécification, à la non-attente, aux écarts, aux contrôles du changement et aux mesures correctives et préventives. - Fournir un soutien technique opportun aux unités de laboratoire du CQ pour assurer la fiabilité des opérations de laboratoire. - Appuyer les activités d'inspection et de préparation à la vérification, y compris les évaluations des lacunes, les mesures d'assainissement et la participation aux inspections des clients ou des autorités sanitaires au besoin. - Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des flux automatisés de données, des améliorations des processus de laboratoire et des initiatives d'amélioration pratique des processus. - Soutenir les attentes en matière d'intégrité des données en assurant la fiabilité, l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude et la conformité des dossiers de laboratoire. - Collaborer avec les équipes de la qualité, de la fabrication, de la science et de la technologie de la fabrication, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de l'entretien et des installations, de l'approvisionnement, de l'informatique et des systèmes de laboratoire mondiaux. - Adhérer au GMPc, à la qualité, à l'ESS et aux procédures du site. - Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de la qualité, aux initiatives en matière de sécurité, aux rapports sur les écarts et au suivi quasi manquant. - Démontrer les valeurs scientifiques de Thermo Fisher par la responsabilisation, le comportement éthique, l'orientation client, la curiosité intellectuelle et la collaboration. ##
• Qualifications requises - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la vie (chimie, biochimie, physique, microbiologie ou équivalent) - Ou de l'informatique/l'automatisation avec une solide connaissance et expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique - Bonne connaissance des règlements sur les BPF, des systèmes de qualité et des exigences de conformité des laboratoires. - Expérience importante dans un environnement de laboratoire, expérience en TI (programmation ou base de données) - Validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV) et de l'industrie pharmaceutique Expérience dans les systèmes d'exécution de laboratoire comme SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. est un avantage - Capacité démontrée d'analyser les données et d'appuyer les enquêtes sur les résultats non spécifiques ou atypiques. - De solides compétences en documentation et la capacité de suivre les procédures écrites et verbales avec exactitude. - Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de l'information en laboratoire et des systèmes de laboratoire électroniques. - Connaissance des normes réglementaires pertinentes, y compris l'ISO, la FDA, l'USP et les attentes du PE. - Excellente attention aux détails, aux compétences organisationnelles et à la gestion du temps. - Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration dans un environnement d'équipe.

## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Description

- Manage and enhance strategic sourcing initiatives for comparator drugs
- Work with cross-functional teams to develop sourcing strategies that ensure the reliable and cost-effective supply of comparator products for clinical studies.
- Negotiate pricing, support and develop supply agreements, and commercial terms with pharmaceutical manufacturers, wholesalers, and specialty suppliers.
- Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships to support global clinical trial requirements.
- Deliver value through cost savings, risk mitigation, and supply chain optimization.
- Support customer bids, RFIs, RFQs, and feasibility assessments through sourcing expertise and market intelligence.
- Monitor market trends, product availability, and supply risks, proactively identifying alternative sourcing strategies when required.
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to manage shortages, mitigate supply chain risks, and ensure continuity of supply.
- Support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
- Ensure a reliable, compliant, and cost-effective procurement of comparator drugs,

## Requirements

- Advanced Degree plus 3 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of procurement/sourcing experience in mid-to-large multinational companies, with strong category management expertise.
- Preferred Fields of Study: Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field.
- Professional certifications (CPSM, CSCP, CPM, MCIPS) are desirable.
- Proven success executing strategic sourcing initiatives, supplier negotiations, and contract management.
- Demonstrated experience sourcing comparator drugs, ancillary supplies, or other clinical trial materials preferred.
- Experience working in regulated industries such as life sciences, clinical research, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or medical devices preferred.
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical supply chains, global sourcing markets, and supplier networks is highly desirable.
- Experience working with pharmaceutical manufacturers, wholesalers, and specialty suppliers preferred.
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
- Proficiency with ERP systems, spend analytics, and procurement tools.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to build consensus and collaborate across global matrix organizations.
- Demonstrated success in achieving cost savings and process improvements.
- Strong project management capabilities.
- Ability to travel 5-25% or as required depending on skillset
- Fluency in English required; additional languages beneficial.
- Comprehensive understanding of procurement best practices, processes, and methodologies.
- Experience with continuous improvement/lean methodologies.
- Demonstrated negotiation and supplier relationship management skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Description

- Manage and enhance strategic sourcing initiatives for comparator drugs
- Work with cross-functional teams to develop sourcing strategies that ensure the reliable and cost-effective supply of comparator products for clinical studies.

- Support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
- Ensure a reliable, compliant, and cost-effective procurement of comparator drugs,

- Advanced Degree plus 3 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of procurement/sourcing experience in mid-to-large multinational companies, with strong category management expertise.

- Demonstrated experience sourcing comparator drugs, ancillary supplies, or other clinical trial materials preferred.
- Experience working in regulated industries such as life sciences, clinical research, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, or medical devices preferred.
- Knowledge of pharmaceutical supply chains, global sourcing markets, and supplier networks is highly desirable.
- Experience working with pharmaceutical manufacturers, wholesalers, and specialty suppliers preferred.

- Proficiency with ERP systems, spend analytics, and procurement tools.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to build consensus and collaborate across global matrix organizations.
- Demonstrated success in achieving cost savings and process improvements.
- Strong project management capabilities.
- Ability to travel 5-25% or as required depending on skillset
- Fluency in English required; additional languages beneficial.
- Comprehensive understanding of procurement best practices, processes, and methodologies.
- Experience with continuous improvement/lean methodologies.
- Demonstrated negotiation and supplier relationship management skills.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Engineering - Clinical Trials
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

*Thermo Fisher Scientific Clinical Trials Division (CTD) is a rapidly growing, dynamic end-to-end pharma services platform that is seeking sharp individuals to bring the highest quality processes, products and testing to our clients. Our employees are committed to making a difference in our organization, for our client partners and the patients we serve.*

## The job:

The Regional Director, Engineering provides strategic engineering leadership across the region (Americas or EMEA) ensuring engineering capability, capital investment, asset reliability, infrastructure planning, and engineering governance support the long-term growth of the Clinical Trials Division. Reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering for CTD, this role is accountable for developing regional engineering strategy, leading the regional capital portfolio, driving engineering standards, enabling operational excellence, and building organizational capability across the engineering network.

The Regional Director partners closely with regional business leaders, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Global Engineering and site leadership to ensure engineering investments are aligned with business priorities while delivering safe, compliant, reliable and scalable operations.

This role can be based at either our Allschwill (Switzerland), or Horsham (UK) sites. It provides oversight to all CTD locations within the EMEA region. Significant time may be spent at the appropriate CTD facilities within the region, including up to 50% travel to network locations globally.

## What will you do?

## Strategic Leadership

- Develop and execute the regional engineering strategy aligned with CTD business objectives, driving long-term infrastructure, engineering capability, and operational excellence across the regional network.
- Lead regional engineering planning, including site master plans, multi-year capital investment strategies, and engineering roadmaps that support business growth, capacity expansion, and business continuity.
- Drive standardization and governance by establishing consistent engineering standards, project governance, and best practices while ensuring alignment with global engineering initiatives and regulatory requirements.
- Partner with regional and global leadership to prioritize strategic investments, develop engineering organizational capability, and build a high-performing engineering culture through talent development, succession planning, and cross-functional collaboration.

## Technical Leadership

- Provide strategic engineering leadership to regional sites, ensuring facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and infrastructure support safe, compliant, and efficient operations.
- Drive engineering excellence by standardizing technical practices, promoting innovation, and leveraging enterprise expertise to improve reliability, scalability, and operational performance.
- Lead technical risk management, including asset lifecycle planning, infrastructure modernization, sustainability initiatives, and engineering support for business growth and client opportunities.
- Develop engineering capability by coaching engineering leaders, fostering technical excellence, and building a strong pipeline of engineering talent across the region.

## Capital Portfolio & Project Management

- Own the regional capital investment portfolio, establishing priorities that align with strategic business objectives, regulatory requirements, and operational needs.
- Lead capital governance by ensuring consistent project management standards, portfolio reviews, business case development, and effective allocation of engineering resources.
- Ensure successful project execution by driving delivery to scope, schedule, budget, quality, and operational readiness while proactively managing project risks.
- Monitor portfolio performance through standardized metrics, financial oversight, and executive reporting to ensure achievement of business value and return on investment.

## Engineering Governance & Operational Excellence

- Establish and sustain regional engineering governance, driving standardized engineering processes, decision-making, and compliance with corporate engineering standards.
- Lead operational excellence initiatives focused on maintenance and reliability, asset utilization, predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement across the regional network.
- Drive implementation of engineering standards for capital execution, equipment lifecycle management, and facility operations to improve consistency and operational performance.
- Measure and improve engineering performance through KPIs, bench-marking, and data-driven initiatives that enhance reliability, productivity, and cost effectiveness.

## Who we are looking for:

## Education:

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific where you'll make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Senior Scientist, you will support the establishment and operational readiness of the Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) unit at the Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau site in accordance with project timelines. Key responsibilities include contributing to the transfer, verification, and validation of analytical methods, as well as the qualification of laboratory equipment required for testing activities. The role also actively supports GMP inspection readiness by ensuring compliance with applicable Quality Systems, procedures, and documentation requirements. In addition, it contributes to overall QC operational readiness through the management and coordination of internal and external projects, resource allocation, and the planning and prioritization of daily team activities. This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth while working alongside colleagues who share your commitment to science and quality.

## Position Summary:

The Senior Scientist Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) plays a key role in establishing, implementing, and maintaining compliant QC processes and analytical methods for the testing of finished products, in-process controls, intermediates, raw materials, utilities, and cleaning samples.

The position combines scientific expertise, GMP compliance, and project leadership. The Senior Scientist is responsible for coordinating analytical activities, supporting the implementation and lifecycle management of methods and equipment, leading local and global QC projects, and ensuring that activities are completed in accordance with defined quality requirements and timelines.

The role works closely with QC management, internal stakeholders, project teams, external partners, suppliers, contract laboratories, and other functions to ensure operational excellence and continuous improvement within BCQC.

## Responsibilities:

## Processes and Analytical Methods Implementation

The Senior Scientist coordinates activities required to establish and maintain QC processes and analytical methods within the assigned area of expertise. Key responsibilities include:

- Authoring and revising Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and other controlled documents in compliance with GMP requirements and established timelines.
- Acting as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the review and approval of analytical methods, plans, protocols, reports, and other technical documentation.
- Coordinating the procurement, qualification, calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of analytical and laboratory infrastructure equipment.
- Supporting the procurement, preparation, manufacturing, qualification, and verification of test, reference, and control materials.
- Coordinating and executing the development, transfer, verification, qualification, and validation of analytical procedures according to applicable regulatory requirements and project timelines.
- Reviewing analytical raw data, equipment qualification and maintenance records, and other relevant BCQC documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity, and GMP compliance.
- Ensuring that analytical processes and methods are appropriately implemented and maintained to support reliable and compliant routine QC operations.

## Project Leadership

The Senior Scientist represents BCQC in cross-functional projects, working groups, and local and global initiatives and ensures that project requirements, resources, workload, timelines, and deliverables are clearly defined.

Key responsibilities include:

- Leading the implementation of local and global projects within QC and ensuring effective planning and execution of assigned activities.
- Translating project requirements into clear, data-driven workload and resource plans.
- Coordinating allocated resources in collaboration with QC management and other QC functions to ensure that timelines and project objectives are achieved.
- Driving collaboration within project teams and ensuring alignment with company strategy, priorities, and core values.
- Facilitating effective and timely communication within project teams and across relevant stakeholders.
- Leading and supporting structured problem-solving activities when issues arise in connection with assigned projects or tasks.
- Monitoring project progress, risks, milestones, deliverables, and KPIs and escalating potential delays or issues when appropriate.
- Promoting accountability by communicating expectations, ensuring transparency of relevant information, and proactively addressing or escalating conflicts and challenges.
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening QC compliance, efficiency, quality, and overall performance.
- Establishing and maintaining effective relationships with external partners, including suppliers, contract laboratories, service providers, and universities.

## QC Execution and Compliance

The Senior Scientist supports the compliant and timely execution of routine and non-routine QC activities and ensures appropriate documentation of analytical work. Responsibilities include:

- Ensuring that raw data, analytical results, reports, logbooks, and other relevant records are accurately documented, reviewed, and retained in accordance with applicable procedures and data integrity requirements.
- Supporting the investigation and resolution of analytical and quality-related issues, including requests associated with biochemical and chemical testing.
- Ensuring that deviations and laboratory investigations are initiated, investigated, documented, and completed in a timely and compliant manner.
- Providing scientific and technical expertise to support investigations, root cause analysis, and the definition of appropriate corrective and preventive actions, where applicable.
- Supporting responses to internal stakeholders, customers, sponsors, auditors, and Health Authority requests related to the assigned area of responsibility.
- Keeping the Head of BCQC appropriately informed regarding ongoing activities, project status, risks, and significant issues.
- Ensuring effective and transparent communication of relevant information to sponsors, stakeholders, project teams, and QC colleagues.

## Team Support and Development

The Senior Scientist contributes to the development of a strong, collaborative, and compliant QC organization by:

- Providing scientific and technical guidance to QC colleagues.
- Mentoring and supporting team members in GMP, Quality Control principles, analytical methods, and laboratory best practices.
- Supporting the planning and coordination of team activities and resources according to operational and project priorities.
- Contributing to recruitment activities and the onboarding and development of new team members.
- Promoting a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and GMP compliance.

## Requirements:

- Degree (Master or higher) in biochemical / chemical/ pharmaceutical/ molecular sciences or similar
- Lower educational background could be accepted, as applicable, in case of former experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Molecular Biology or related scientific field
- Min 2 years experience in GMP regulated industry
- 3-5 years lab experience
- Additional certifications in Quality Control/GMP practices beneficial
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations and quality systems requirements
- Proficiency in analytical techniques including HPLC, GC, MS, spectrophotometry
- Experience with biochemical testing methods
- Strong documentation skills and proficiency with laboratory information management systems
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards (ISO, FDA, USP, EP)
- Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow written/verbal procedures accurately
- Strong organizational and time management skills
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
- Experience with laboratory automation systems preferred

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

Ufficio

## Descrizione del lavoro

Unisciti al nostro team di controllo qualità presso Thermo Fisher Scientific dove potrai dare contributi significativi alla nostra missione di consentire ai clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. In qualità di Senior Scientist, supporterete l'istituzione e la disponibilità operativa dell'unità Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) presso il sito Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau in conformità ai tempi del progetto. Le responsabilità chiave includono il contributo al trasferimento, alla verifica e alla convalida dei metodi analitici, nonché la qualificazione delle attrezzature di laboratorio necessarie per le attività di test. Il ruolo supporta inoltre attivamente la prontezza dell'ispezione GMP assicurando la conformità ai requisiti di qualità, procedure e documentazione applicabili. Inoltre, contribuisce alla prontezza operativa del QC globale attraverso la gestione e il coordinamento di progetti interni ed esterni, allocazione delle risorse, e la pianificazione e la priorità delle attività quotidiane del team. Questo ruolo offre eccellenti opportunità per la crescita professionale, lavorando insieme a colleghi che condividono il vostro impegno per la scienza e la qualità.

## Posizione Riepilogo:

Il Senior Scientist Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) svolge un ruolo chiave nello stabilire, implementare e mantenere i processi QC conformi e i metodi analitici per la sperimentazione di prodotti finiti, controlli in-process, intermedi, materie prime, utilità e campioni di pulizia.

La posizione combina competenze scientifiche, conformità GMP e leadership di progetto. Lo scienziato senior è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività analitiche, sostenendo l'implementazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei metodi e delle attrezzature, i principali progetti QC locali e globali, e assicurando che le attività siano completate in conformità con i requisiti di qualità definiti e le tempistiche.

Il ruolo lavora a stretto contatto con la gestione di QC, gli stakeholder interni, i team di progetto, i partner esterni, i fornitori, i laboratori contrattuali e altre funzioni per garantire l'eccellenza operativa e il miglioramento continuo all'interno di BCQC.

## Responsabilità:

## Processi e metodi analitici Attuazione

Lo scienziato senior coordina le attività necessarie per stabilire e mantenere i processi QC e i metodi analitici all'interno dell'area di competenza assegnata. Le responsabilità chiave includono:

- Autorizzazione e revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP), Istruzioni di lavoro (WIs), e altri documenti controllati in conformità ai requisiti GMP e tempi stabiliti.
- In qualità di Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) per la revisione e l'approvazione di metodi analitici, piani, protocolli, relazioni e altri documenti tecnici.
- Coordinare l'approvvigionamento, la qualificazione, la calibrazione, la manutenzione e la gestione del ciclo di vita delle attrezzature analitiche e di laboratorio.
- Sostenere l'approvvigionamento, la preparazione, la produzione, la qualificazione e la verifica dei materiali di prova, di riferimento e di controllo.
- Coordinamento ed esecuzione dello sviluppo, del trasferimento, della verifica, della qualificazione e della validazione delle procedure analitiche secondo i requisiti normativi applicabili e le tempistiche del progetto.
- La revisione dei dati analitici grezzi, delle qualifiche e dei registri di manutenzione delle attrezzature e di altre documentazioni BCQC pertinenti per garantire accuratezza, completezza, integrità dei dati e conformità GMP.
- Garantire che i processi e i metodi analitici siano adeguatamente implementati e mantenuti per supportare operazioni QC di routine affidabili e conformi.

## Leadership del progetto

Lo scienziato senior rappresenta BCQC in progetti interfunzionali, gruppi di lavoro e iniziative locali e globali e assicura che i requisiti di progetto, le risorse, il carico di lavoro, le linee temporali e i consegnabili siano chiaramente definiti.

Le responsabilità chiave includono:

- Condurre l'implementazione di progetti locali e globali all'interno del QC e garantire una pianificazione efficace e l'esecuzione delle attività assegnate.
- Tradurre i requisiti del progetto in piani di lavoro chiari e basati sui dati.
- Coordinamento delle risorse assegnate in collaborazione con la gestione del QC e altre funzioni del QC per garantire che vengano raggiunti tempi e obiettivi di progetto.
- Guidare la collaborazione all'interno dei team di progetto e garantire l'allineamento con la strategia aziendale, le priorità e i valori fondamentali.
- Facilitare una comunicazione efficace e tempestiva all'interno dei team di progetto e di tutti gli stakeholder rilevanti.
- Leader e supporto alle attività strutturate di problem solving quando i problemi si presentano in relazione a progetti o compiti assegnati.
- Monitoraggio del progresso del progetto, dei rischi, delle pietre miliari, dei materiali consegnabili e dei KPI e aumento dei potenziali ritardi o problemi quando necessario.
- Promuovere la responsabilità comunicando le aspettative, garantendo trasparenza delle informazioni pertinenti e affrontando in modo proattivo o intensificando i conflitti e le sfide.
- Sostenere iniziative di miglioramento continuo finalizzate a rafforzare la conformità, l'efficienza, la qualità e le prestazioni globali.
- Stabilire e mantenere relazioni efficaci con partner esterni, compresi fornitori, laboratori contrattuali, fornitori di servizi e università.

## Esecuzione e conformità di QC

Lo scienziato senior supporta l'esecuzione puntuale e puntuale delle attività QC di routine e non-routine e garantisce la documentazione appropriata del lavoro analitico. Le responsabilità includono:

- Garantire che i dati grezzi, i risultati analitici, i report, i logbook e altri record pertinenti siano documentati, riesaminati e conservati in conformità alle procedure applicabili e ai requisiti di integrità dei dati.
- Sostenere l'indagine e la risoluzione di problemi analitici e di qualità, comprese le richieste associate a test biochimici e chimici.
- Assicurarsi che le deviazioni e le indagini di laboratorio siano avviate, indagate, documentate e completate in modo tempestivo e conforme.
- Fornire competenze scientifiche e tecniche per sostenere le indagini, l'analisi delle cause principali e la definizione di azioni correttive e preventive appropriate, ove applicabile.
- Sostenere le risposte alle richieste delle parti interessate, dei clienti, degli sponsor, dei revisori e delle autorità sanitarie relative all'area di responsabilità assegnata.
- Mantenere il Capo di BCQC adeguatamente informato circa le attività in corso, lo stato del progetto, i rischi e le questioni significative.
- Garantire una comunicazione efficace e trasparente delle informazioni pertinenti a sponsor, stakeholder, team di progetto e colleghi QC.

## Supporto e sviluppo del team

Lo scienziato senior contribuisce allo sviluppo di un'organizzazione QC forte, collaborativa e conforme da:

- Fornire una guida scientifica e tecnica ai colleghi del QC.
- Mentori e membri del team di supporto in GMP, principi di controllo qualità, metodi analitici e best practice di laboratorio.
- Sostenere la pianificazione e il coordinamento delle attività e delle risorse del team in base alle priorità operative e di progetto.
- Contribuire alle attività di reclutamento e alla formazione e sviluppo di nuovi membri del team.
- Promuovere una cultura di qualità, responsabilità, collaborazione, miglioramento continuo e conformità GMP.

## Requisiti:

- Laurea (Master o superiore) in scienze biochimiche / chimiche/ farmaceutiche/ molecolari o simili
- In caso di esperienza precedente nell'industria farmaceutica, si potrebbe accettare un basso background educativo.
- Campi di studio: Chimica, Biochimica, Biologia, Biologia Molecolare o relativo campo scientifico
- Min 2 anni di esperienza nel settore regolamentato GMP
- 3-5 anni di esperienza di laboratorio
- Certificazioni aggiuntive in Quality Control/GMP pratiche benefiche
- Forte conoscenza delle normative GMP e dei requisiti dei sistemi di qualità
- Proficienza nelle tecniche analitiche tra cui HPLC, GC, MS, spettrofotometria
- Esperienza con metodi di test biochimici
- Forte capacità di documentazione e competenza con sistemi di gestione dell'informazione di laboratorio
- Conoscenza dei pertinenti standard normativi (ISO, FDA, USP, EP)
- Ottima attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di seguire accuratamente le procedure scritte/verbali
- Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo in un ambiente di team
- Proficienza nelle applicazioni Microsoft Office
- Chiara capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese
- Esperienza con sistemi di automazione di laboratorio preferiti

## Job Description

Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific where you'll make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As a Senior Scientist, you will support the establishment and operational readiness of the Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) unit at the Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau site in accordance with project timelines. Key responsibilities include contributing to the transfer, verification, and validation of analytical methods, as well as the qualification of laboratory equipment required for testing activities. The role also actively supports GMP inspection readiness by ensuring compliance with applicable Quality Systems, procedures, and documentation requirements. In addition, it contributes to overall QC operational readiness through the management and coordination of internal and external projects, resource allocation, and the planning and prioritization of daily team activities. This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth while working alongside colleagues who share your commitment to science and quality.

## Position Summary:

The Senior Scientist Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) plays a key role in establishing, implementing, and maintaining compliant QC processes and analytical methods for the testing of finished products, in-process controls, intermediates, raw materials, utilities, and cleaning samples.

The position combines scientific expertise, GMP compliance, and project leadership. The Senior Scientist is responsible for coordinating analytical activities, supporting the implementation and lifecycle management of methods and equipment, leading local and global QC projects, and ensuring that activities are completed in accordance with defined quality requirements and timelines.

The role works closely with QC management, internal stakeholders, project teams, external partners, suppliers, contract laboratories, and other functions to ensure operational excellence and continuous improvement within BCQC.

## Responsibilities:

## Processes and Analytical Methods Implementation

The Senior Scientist coordinates activities required to establish and maintain QC processes and analytical methods within the assigned area of expertise. Key responsibilities include:

- Authoring and revising Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), and other controlled documents in compliance with GMP requirements and established timelines.
- Acting as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the review and approval of analytical methods, plans, protocols, reports, and other technical documentation.
- Coordinating the procurement, qualification, calibration, maintenance, and lifecycle management of analytical and laboratory infrastructure equipment.
- Supporting the procurement, preparation, manufacturing, qualification, and verification of test, reference, and control materials.
- Coordinating and executing the development, transfer, verification, qualification, and validation of analytical procedures according to applicable regulatory requirements and project timelines.
- Reviewing analytical raw data, equipment qualification and maintenance records, and other relevant BCQC documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity, and GMP compliance.
- Ensuring that analytical processes and methods are appropriately implemented and maintained to support reliable and compliant routine QC operations.

## Project Leadership

The Senior Scientist represents BCQC in cross-functional projects, working groups, and local and global initiatives and ensures that project requirements, resources, workload, timelines, and deliverables are clearly defined.

Key responsibilities include:

- Leading the implementation of local and global projects within QC and ensuring effective planning and execution of assigned activities.
- Translating project requirements into clear, data-driven workload and resource plans.
- Coordinating allocated resources in collaboration with QC management and other QC functions to ensure that timelines and project objectives are achieved.
- Driving collaboration within project teams and ensuring alignment with company strategy, priorities, and core values.
- Facilitating effective and timely communication within project teams and across relevant stakeholders.
- Leading and supporting structured problem-solving activities when issues arise in connection with assigned projects or tasks.
- Monitoring project progress, risks, milestones, deliverables, and KPIs and escalating potential delays or issues when appropriate.
- Promoting accountability by communicating expectations, ensuring transparency of relevant information, and proactively addressing or escalating conflicts and challenges.
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening QC compliance, efficiency, quality, and overall performance.
- Establishing and maintaining effective relationships with external partners, including suppliers, contract laboratories, service providers, and universities.

## QC Execution and Compliance

The Senior Scientist supports the compliant and timely execution of routine and non-routine QC activities and ensures appropriate documentation of analytical work. Responsibilities include:

- Ensuring that raw data, analytical results, reports, logbooks, and other relevant records are accurately documented, reviewed, and retained in accordance with applicable procedures and data integrity requirements.
- Supporting the investigation and resolution of analytical and quality-related issues, including requests associated with biochemical and chemical testing.
- Ensuring that deviations and laboratory investigations are initiated, investigated, documented, and completed in a timely and compliant manner.
- Providing scientific and technical expertise to support investigations, root cause analysis, and the definition of appropriate corrective and preventive actions, where applicable.
- Supporting responses to internal stakeholders, customers, sponsors, auditors, and Health Authority requests related to the assigned area of responsibility.
- Keeping the Head of BCQC appropriately informed regarding ongoing activities, project status, risks, and significant issues.
- Ensuring effective and transparent communication of relevant information to sponsors, stakeholders, project teams, and QC colleagues.

## Team Support and Development

The Senior Scientist contributes to the development of a strong, collaborative, and compliant QC organization by:

- Providing scientific and technical guidance to QC colleagues.
- Mentoring and supporting team members in GMP, Quality Control principles, analytical methods, and laboratory best practices.
- Supporting the planning and coordination of team activities and resources according to operational and project priorities.
- Contributing to recruitment activities and the onboarding and development of new team members.
- Promoting a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and GMP compliance.

## Requirements:

- Degree (Master or higher) in biochemical / chemical/ pharmaceutical/ molecular sciences or similar
- Lower educational background could be accepted, as applicable, in case of former experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Preferred Fields of Study: Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Molecular Biology or related scientific field
- Min 2 years experience in GMP regulated industry
- 3-5 years lab experience
- Additional certifications in Quality Control/GMP practices beneficial
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations and quality systems requirements
- Proficiency in analytical techniques including HPLC, GC, MS, spectrophotometry
- Experience with biochemical testing methods
- Strong documentation skills and proficiency with laboratory information management systems
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards (ISO, FDA, USP, EP)
- Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow written/verbal procedures accurately
- Strong organizational and time management skills
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
- Experience with laboratory automation systems preferred

## Stellenbeschreibung

Treten Sie unserem Qualitätskontrollteam von Thermo Fisher Scientific bei, wo Sie einen bedeutenden Beitrag zu unserer Mission leisten, Kunden zu ermöglichen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen. Als Senior Scientist unterstützen Sie den Aufbau und die Einsatzbereitschaft der Abteilung Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) am Standort Thermo Fisher Scientific Lengnau gemäß den Projektzeitplänen. Zu den Hauptverantwortlichkeiten gehören der Beitrag zur Übertragung, Verifizierung und Validierung von Analysemethoden sowie die Qualifizierung von Laborgeräten, die für Testaktivitäten erforderlich sind. Die Rolle unterstützt auch aktiv die GMP-Prüfbereitschaft, indem sie die Einhaltung der geltenden Qualitätssicherungssysteme, Verfahren und Dokumentationsanforderungen gewährleistet. Darüber hinaus trägt es zur allgemeinen Einsatzbereitschaft des QC durch das Management und die Koordination interner und externer Projekte, die Ressourcenzuweisung sowie die Planung und Priorisierung der täglichen Teamaktivitäten bei. Diese Rolle bietet hervorragende Möglichkeiten für berufliches Wachstum, während Sie mit Kollegen zusammenarbeiten, die Ihr Engagement für Wissenschaft und Qualität teilen.

## Positionsübersicht:

Der Senior Scientist Bio-/Chemical Quality Control (BCQC) spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Etablierung, Implementierung und Aufrechterhaltung konformer QC-Prozesse und Analysemethoden für die Prüfung von Fertigprodukten, In-Prozess-Kontrollen, Zwischenprodukten, Rohstoffen, Dienstprogrammen und Reinigungsproben.

Die Position vereint wissenschaftliche Expertise, GMP-Compliance und Projektführung. Der Senior Scientist ist verantwortlich für die Koordination analytischer Aktivitäten, die Unterstützung der Implementierung und des Lebenszyklusmanagements von Methoden und Geräten, die Leitung lokaler und globaler QC-Projekte und die Sicherstellung, dass die Aktivitäten in Übereinstimmung mit definierten Qualitätsanforderungen und Zeitplänen abgeschlossen werden.

Die Rolle arbeitet eng mit dem QC-Management, internen Stakeholdern, Projektteams, externen Partnern, Lieferanten, Vertragslabors und anderen Funktionen zusammen, um operative Exzellenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung innerhalb von BCQC sicherzustellen.

## Zuständigkeiten:

## Prozesse und analytische Methoden Implementierung

Der Senior Scientist koordiniert die Aktivitäten, die erforderlich sind, um QC-Prozesse und Analysemethoden innerhalb des zugewiesenen Fachgebiets zu etablieren und zu pflegen. Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören:

- Verfassen und Überarbeiten von Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Arbeitsanweisungen (WIs) und anderen kontrollierten Dokumenten in Übereinstimmung mit den GMP-Anforderungen und festgelegten Zeitplänen.
- Tätigkeit als Subject Matter Expert (SME) für die Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Analysemethoden, Plänen, Protokollen, Berichten und anderen technischen Dokumentationen.
- Koordinierung der Beschaffung, Qualifizierung, Kalibrierung, Wartung und des Lebenszyklusmanagements von Analyse- und Laborinfrastrukturgeräten.
- Unterstützung der Beschaffung, Vorbereitung, Herstellung, Qualifizierung und Verifizierung von Test-, Referenz- und Kontrollmaterialien.
- Koordinierung und Durchführung der Entwicklung, Übertragung, Verifizierung, Qualifizierung und Validierung von Analyseverfahren gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Anforderungen und Projektzeitplänen.
- Überprüfung analytischer Rohdaten, Ausrüstungsqualifikations- und Wartungsaufzeichnungen und anderer relevanter BCQC-Dokumentationen, um Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit, Datenintegrität und GMP-Compliance sicherzustellen.
- Sicherstellen, dass analytische Prozesse und Methoden angemessen implementiert und gewartet werden, um zuverlässige und konforme Routine-QC-Operationen zu unterstützen.

## Projektleitung

Der Senior Scientist vertritt BCQC in funktionsübergreifenden Projekten, Arbeitsgruppen und lokalen und globalen Initiativen und stellt sicher, dass Projektanforderungen, Ressourcen, Arbeitsbelastung, Zeitpläne und Ergebnisse klar definiert sind.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören:

- Leitung der Umsetzung lokaler und globaler Projekte innerhalb von QC und Gewährleistung einer effektiven Planung und Durchführung zugewiesener Aktivitäten.
- Übersetzen von Projektanforderungen in klare, datengesteuerte Workload- und Ressourcenpläne.
- Koordination der zugewiesenen Ressourcen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem QC-Management und anderen QC-Funktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass Zeitpläne und Projektziele erreicht werden.
- Förderung der Zusammenarbeit in Projektteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf Unternehmensstrategie, Prioritäten und Kernwerte.
- Ermöglichung einer effektiven und zeitnahen Kommunikation innerhalb der Projektteams und zwischen den relevanten Interessengruppen.
- Leitung und Unterstützung strukturierter Problemlösungsaktivitäten, wenn Probleme im Zusammenhang mit zugewiesenen Projekten oder Aufgaben auftreten.
- Überwachung des Projektfortschritts, der Risiken, Meilensteine, Ergebnisse und KPIs sowie gegebenenfalls Eskalation potenzieller Verzögerungen oder Probleme.
- Förderung der Rechenschaftspflicht durch die Vermittlung von Erwartungen, die Gewährleistung der Transparenz relevanter Informationen und die proaktive Bewältigung oder Eskalation von Konflikten und Herausforderungen.
- Unterstützung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Stärkung der QC-Compliance, Effizienz, Qualität und Gesamtleistung.
- Aufbau und Pflege effektiver Beziehungen zu externen Partnern, einschließlich Lieferanten, Vertragslaboratorien, Dienstleistern und Universitäten.

## QC Ausführung und Compliance

Der Senior Scientist unterstützt die konforme und zeitnahe Durchführung von Routine- und Nicht-Routine-QC-Aktivitäten und sorgt für eine angemessene Dokumentation der analytischen Arbeit. Zu den Aufgaben gehören:

- Gewährleistung, dass Rohdaten, Analyseergebnisse, Berichte, Logbücher und andere relevante Aufzeichnungen gemäß den geltenden Verfahren und Datenintegritätsanforderungen genau dokumentiert, überprüft und aufbewahrt werden.
- Unterstützung der Untersuchung und Lösung analytischer und qualitätsbezogener Fragen, einschließlich Anfragen im Zusammenhang mit biochemischen und chemischen Tests.
- Gewährleistung, dass Abweichungen und Laboruntersuchungen zeitnah und konform eingeleitet, untersucht, dokumentiert und abgeschlossen werden.
- Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichem und technischem Fachwissen zur Unterstützung von Untersuchungen, Ursachenanalysen und gegebenenfalls Festlegung geeigneter Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen.
- Unterstützung von Antworten auf interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Sponsoren, Auditoren und Anfragen der Gesundheitsbehörde im Zusammenhang mit dem zugewiesenen Verantwortungsbereich.
- Den Leiter des BCQC angemessen über laufende Aktivitäten, Projektstatus, Risiken und wichtige Fragen zu informieren.
- Gewährleistung einer effektiven und transparenten Kommunikation relevanter Informationen an Sponsoren, Stakeholder, Projektteams und QC-Kollegen.

## Team Support und Entwicklung

Der Senior Scientist trägt zur Entwicklung einer starken, kollaborativen und konformen QC-Organisation bei, indem er:

- Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher und technischer Unterstützung für QC-Kollegen.
- Mentoring und Unterstützung von Teammitgliedern in GMP, Qualitätskontrollprinzipien, Analysemethoden und Best Practices im Labor.
- Unterstützung bei der Planung und Koordination von Teamaktivitäten und -ressourcen entsprechend den operativen und Projektprioritäten.
- Beitrag zur Rekrutierung und zum Onboarding und zur Entwicklung neuer Teammitglieder.
- Förderung einer Kultur der Qualität, Rechenschaftspflicht, Zusammenarbeit, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und GMP-Compliance.

## Anforderungen:

- Abschluss (Master oder höher) in biochemischen / chemischen / pharmazeutischen / molekularen Wissenschaften oder ähnlichem
- Ein niedrigerer Bildungshintergrund könnte gegebenenfalls bei früheren Erfahrungen in der pharmazeutischen Industrie akzeptiert werden
- Bevorzugte Studienrichtungen: Chemie, Biochemie, Biologie, Molekularbiologie oder verwandte wissenschaftliche Bereiche
- Min 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der GMP regulierten Industrie
- 3-5 Jahre Laborerfahrung
- Zusätzliche Zertifizierungen in der Qualitätskontrolle / GMP-Praktiken vorteilhaft
- Umfangreiches Wissen über GMP-Vorschriften und Anforderungen an Qualitätssysteme
- Kenntnisse in Analysetechniken einschließlich HPLC, GC, MS, Spektrophotometrie
- Erfahrung mit biochemischen Prüfmethoden
- Starke Dokumentationskompetenzen und Kenntnisse in Laborinformationsmanagementsystemen
- Kenntnis der relevanten regulatorischen Standards (ISO, FDA, USP, EP)
- Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeit, schriftliche / mündliche Verfahren genau zu befolgen
- Starke organisatorische und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch kooperativ in einer Teamumgebung zu arbeiten
- Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office-Anwendungen
- Klare schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch
- Erfahrung mit Laborautomatisierungssystemen bevorzugt
